000b7842d0e0.en: Sinoi just made another short burst of noise that resembled words, now sounding more annoyed, “Ju’sta’i’ridg.” He didn’t even look at the map or Harry.
000b7842d0e0.t: Sinoi hanya membuat satu lagi letusan bunyi singkat yang menyerupai perkataan, kini kedengaran lebih jengkel, “Du’k’je’dlm’ke’ra’.” Dia tidak memandang peta atau Harry pun.

00a80f9a22e7.en: Gripping his badge tightly, Harry nodded as his eyes also grew wet. “Thanks, Eiri. Thanks, Sora!” He could feel this sensation of freedom he had never felt before, but part of him still wanted to stay at Sanbi Castle for a bit longer. He looked back at the massive door as the guard strained himself hard to close it. His chest gripped with a longing already developing, but it wasn’t as strong as the excitement of jumping into the unknown.
00a80f9a22e7.t: Menggenggam lencananya erat-erat, Harry mengangguk sementara matanya turut basah. “Terima kasih, Eiri. Terima kasih, Sora!” Dia dapat merasakan sensasi kebebasan yang tidak pernah dirasainya sebelum ini, tetapi sebahagian dirinya masih mahu tinggal di Istana Sanbi sedikit lagi. Dia menoleh ke arah pintu besar itu ketika pengawal bersusah payah menutupnya. Dadanya dicengkam kerinduan yang sudah mula terbentuk, tetapi ia tidak sekuat keterujaan melompat ke alam yang tidak diketahui.

0359b5f8d118.en: “My badge!” Harry cried out amidst shallow breaths. Standing sloppily up, he cleaned away the dirt from his eyes as he forced his spazzing leg forward. The stitching pain contrasted with the lightheadedness he was developing. All that slowed him down to a zombie crawl as he pushed himself to move forward, one step at time.
0359b5f8d118.t: “Lencana saya!” Harry menangis di tengah-tengah nafas yang cetek. Berdiri dengan selekeh, dia mengesat tanah dari matanya sambil memaksa kakinya yang kejang ke depan. Kesakitan menjahit kontras dengan rasa pening yang mula dialaminya. Semua itu memperlahankannya menjadi rangkakan seperti zombi ketika dia memaksa dirinya bergerak ke depan, selangkah demi selangkah.

05b8254f898b.en: “Since the so-called Sanbi-eye is still here, tell me then—what is Itagiba’s father’s name?” Arukia’s pointy nose looked like it was about to stab Harry in the face like a swordfish.
05b8254f898b.t: “Alang-alang Sanbi-eye yang konon-kononnya ni masih kat sini, bagi tahu aku—siapa nama ayah Itagiba?” Hidung Arukia yang mancung kelihatan seperti hendak menikam muka Harry seperti ikan todak.

0ab499802258.en: “I’m kidding! I’m kidding!” Eiri pointed at a nearby carriage. “Neferteri told me all you need to know about your new job is in the bag and that Sinoi would give you extra details, so have fun, Harry! Sora and I will be here waiting for you!” Eiri winked. “I will make sure no one else proposes to her!”
0ab499802258.t: “Aku gurau! Aku gurau!” Eiri menunjuk ke arah sebuah kereta kuda berdekatan. “Neferteri bagi tahu aku semua yang kau perlu tahu tentang kerja baru kau ada dalam beg tu dan Sinoi akan bagi kau butiran tambahan, jadi berseronoklah, Harry! Aku dan Sora akan tunggu kau kat sini!” Eiri mengenyit mata. “Aku akan pastikan tak ada orang lain yang lamar dia!”

0dae9ce0159b.en: “E-co-no-mi-cal!” Arukia enunicated with the same promiscuous tone as she grabbed the rest of Harry’s sandwich, dipped it into a hearty amount of green sauce, and took a small bite, leaving a red lip mark. With her hand in her mouth, quickly chewing the bite down, she then said, “Who’s the boss of each department?”
0dae9ce0159b.t: “E-ko-no-mi!” Arukia menyebut dengan nada menggoda yang sama sambil mengambil baki sandwic Harry, mencelupnya ke dalam sejumlah besar sos hijau, dan menggigit sedikit, meninggalkan kesan bibir merah. Dengan tangan di mulutnya, cepat-cepat mengunyah gigitan itu, dia kemudian berkata, “Siapa ketua setiap jabatan?”

0dc42e216c2b.en: “FIN’” Sinoi angrily shouted. “Aft’Dea’Woz’I’stop—” Sinoi lashed the egua again, making it canter harder.
0dc42e216c2b.t: “YE’LA’” Sinoi menjerit dengan marah. “Le’Dea’Woz’a’ber’hen—” Sinoi melibas egua itu lagi, membuatkannya berlari lebih laju.

0fa1c456a0f3.en: Eiri helped Harry put the bag over his shoulder, then took a step back to look at the complete uniform—her appearance was like that of a mother about to let her kid go to college but treating them as if they were still in kindergarten. “Everything you need is in the bag. Make sure not to lose it, especially the purse! The badge too! Otherwise, you can’t withdraw more balls at the embassy!” Her eyes grew kindly trembling, coincidentally getting wetter. “I’m happy for you, Harry.”
0fa1c456a0f3.t: Eiri membantu Harry menyandang beg itu di bahunya, kemudian berundur selangkah untuk melihat pakaian seragam yang lengkap—rupanya seperti seorang ibu yang hendak melepaskan anaknya ke kolej tetapi melayan mereka seolah-olah mereka masih di tadika. “Semua yang kau perlukan ada dalam beg tu. Pastikan jangan hilangkan, terutamanya dompet! Lencana juga! Kalau tak, kau tak boleh keluarkan lebih banyak bola kat kedutaan!” Matanya menjadi bergetar dengan penuh kasih, secara kebetulan semakin basah. “Aku gembira untuk kau, Harry.”

0fae778c67b6.en: In the middle of the atrium, surrounded by stairs and a sizeable fost lamp above, Sora stood by with her hands up front, already red in the face—maybe she had rosacea after all or was in a constant state of embarrassment. She bowed apologetically, speaking at such a fast, worried pace that she wasn’t a rap god anymore but the rap universe itself. “I’m sorry, Harry, but I don’t want to marry too young. I have the family business to care for—and—I’m waiting for my prince to arrive!” She quickly paced towards the door leading out of Sanbi Castle, then opened it wide for Eiri and Harry.
0fae778c67b6.t: Di tengah-tengah atrium, dikelilingi tangga dan lampu fost yang agak besar di atas, Sora berdiri dengan tangannya di depan, sudah merah padam—mungkin dia memang menghidap rosasea atau sentiasa dalam keadaan malu. Dia menunduk memohon maaf, bercakap dengan rentak yang begitu laju dan risau sehingga dia bukan lagi dewa rap tetapi alam semesta rap itu sendiri. “Maaf, Harry, tapi saya tak nak kahwin terlalu muda. Saya ada perniagaan keluarga untuk dijaga—dan—saya tengah tunggu putera saya tiba!” Dia cepat-cepat melangkah ke arah pintu yang menuju keluar dari Istana Sanbi, kemudian membukanya luas untuk Eiri dan Harry.

166b16603e79.en: Meanwhile, Harry’s eyes looked to be moistening up on their own. I actually don’t really know shit! Was I supposed to learn stuff? But how? Nobody even told me about it! Not even Eiri! Harry dropped his head as he held the mostly empty plate in his lap. Fingering the leftover sauces, he nibbled on them to appease the culpable feelings rattling in his chest. The white sauce tasted like homemade butter mayonnaise, while the greenish one was akin to black pepper and cumin mixed with a tangy chlorophyll accent. Good on their own, but when he mixed them with the meaty sandwich, they elevated the taste from something bought at a supermarket to one handmade by a world-renowned chef—or perhaps Harry’s hunger could be pushing the flavors to new heights.
166b16603e79.t: Sementara itu, mata Harry kelihatan berkaca dengan sendirinya. Aku sebenarnya tak tahu apa-apa langsung! Aku sepatutnya belajar benda-benda ni ke? Tapi macam mana? Tak ada siapa pun bagi tahu aku! Eiri pun tak! Harry menundukkan kepalanya sambil memegang pinggan yang hampir kosong di ribanya. Mencolek sisa sos, dia menjilatnya untuk menenangkan perasaan bersalah yang bergegar di dadanya. Sos putih rasanya seperti mayonis mentega buatan sendiri, manakala yang kehijauan seperti lada hitam dan jintan putih bercampur aksen klorofil yang masam. Sedap dengan sendirinya, tetapi apabila dia mencampurkannya dengan sandwic berdaging, ia menaikkan rasa dari sesuatu yang dibeli di pasar raya kepada sesuatu yang dibuat tangan oleh cef terkenal dunia—atau mungkin kelaparan Harry yang menolak rasa itu ke tahap baharu.

16cd6aac584a.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 4: Harry hides behind a tree in a dark forest, watching a cart on the road.
16cd6aac584a.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 4: Harry bersembunyi di sebalik pokok dalam hutan gelap, memerhati sebuah kereta di jalan.

1725aca8f78c.en: Harry squealed like a dying pig, sobbing with pure anguish from his heart. The sob became gurgly. The gurgly noises grew weaker as Harry felt a wave of calmness surface from deep within—telling him to just let it go. Wanna—go—home. Harry let go of everything.
1725aca8f78c.t: Harry menjerit seperti babi yang nazak, teresak-esak dengan keperitan tulen dari hatinya. Esakan itu menjadi berdeguk. Bunyi berdeguk itu menjadi semakin lemah ketika Harry merasakan gelombang ketenangan muncul dari dalam—menyuruhnya melepaskan sahaja. Nak—balik—rumah. Harry melepaskan segala-galanya.

189a357433fa.en: Harry’s eyes, initially entranced by the beauty of her fierier-than-the-fireplace cyan eyes, felt a gravity tug towards the valley of fun that her breasts looked like.
189a357433fa.t: Mata Harry, yang pada mulanya terpukau dengan kecantikan mata biru kehijauannya yang lebih berapi daripada pendiang, merasakan tarikan graviti ke arah lembah keseronokan yang kelihatan seperti buah dadanya.

1a5e441169c6.en: Harry’s eyes widened as that challenge seemed too good to be true. Resting his plate on his lap, he narrowed his eyes towards the same white ceiling, but now his eyes were no longer a blurry mess. Eiri just mentioned that! It was—oh yes! He began blurting the answers out, “Monarchy! And—and—soul energy!” Harry kept on searching, but his memories came up short.
1a5e441169c6.t: Mata Harry terbeliak kerana cabaran itu kelihatan terlalu bagus untuk menjadi kenyataan. Meletakkan pinggannya di ribanya, dia mengecilkan matanya ke arah siling putih yang sama, tetapi kini matanya tidak lagi kabur. Eiri baru sebut tadi! Ia—oh ya! Dia mula menghamburkan jawapan, “Monarki! Dan—dan—tenaga jiwa!” Harry terus mencari, tetapi ingatannya gagal.

204f912f9004.en: Another sharp metallic bang went off, making another arrow strike him in his lower back, deep into his stomach. The same vicious girly laugh ensued, now closer than before.
204f912f9004.t: Satu lagi dentuman logam tajam berbunyi, membuatkan satu lagi anak panah mengenainya di pinggang bawah, jauh ke dalam perutnya. Ketawa gadis ganas yang sama menyusul, kini lebih dekat daripada tadi.

20cd4725f7c8.en: Sinoi lazily pulled the reins towards the right, keeping the egua encircling the round castle wall rather than turning left in a T-intersection. Somehow that was the only second signal Sinoi inputted so far. The egua apparently had a decent autopilot to keep encircling the round wall, avoiding people, things, and even the sturdy-looking brick fost lamp that littered the middle of the streets, equally spaced out from one another.
20cd4725f7c8.t: Sinoi dengan malas menarik tali kekang ke kanan, memastikan egua terus mengelilingi tembok istana yang bulat dan bukannya membelok ke kiri di simpang T. Entah bagaimana itu hanya isyarat kedua yang Sinoi berikan setakat ini. Egua itu nampaknya mempunyai juruterbang automatik yang agak baik untuk terus mengelilingi tembok bulat, mengelak orang, benda, malah lampu fost bata yang kelihatan kukuh yang berderet di tengah-tengah jalan, dijarakkan sama rata antara satu sama lain.

236257246e3a.en: Sinoi verged right on another split off on the road, towards a new road that seemed less frequently used. The forest was overgrowing, trying to reclaim the narrow road. Only far echoes of the lively band and villagers could be heard, with the white gloom of the village also growing distant in the sky.
236257246e3a.t: Sinoi membelok ke kanan di satu lagi persimpangan jalan, ke arah jalan baharu yang kelihatan kurang kerap digunakan. Hutan semakin semak, cuba menuntut kembali jalan sempit itu. Hanya gema jauh kumpulan muzik yang meriah dan penduduk kampung yang kedengaran, dengan cahaya putih samar kampung turut semakin jauh di langit.

237bd2b93d1b.en: OH! Fishing Tree! His eyes spotted the village northeast of Sanbi’s capital, by a river flowing into the ocean. Seeing how to get back to the capital, Harry’s eyes followed the dots as they traveled the river upstream to Sanbi East village, which had a connection back to inland travel. From that village back to Sanbi kingdom, it looked like there were multiple stops along the way, with several more throughout the capital. The most populated part, the kingdom’s central region, where the capital lay, looked like a downward triangle. Smack in the middle of that downward triangle was Sanbi Castle, written in large font. Twenty-two pearls? Does that mean it’s far away? Harry’s sense of distance was purely a gut feeling. “Haaa—Sinoi?”
237bd2b93d1b.t: OH! Fishing Tree! Matanya ternampak kampung di timur laut ibu kota Sanbi, di tepi sungai yang mengalir ke lautan. Melihat cara untuk kembali ke ibu kota, mata Harry mengikut titik-titik itu ketika ia menyusuri sungai ke hulu ke kampung Sanbi East, yang mempunyai sambungan kembali ke perjalanan darat. Dari kampung itu kembali ke kerajaan Sanbi, kelihatan ada beberapa hentian di sepanjang jalan, dengan beberapa lagi di seluruh ibu kota. Bahagian paling padat, kawasan tengah kerajaan, di mana ibu kota terletak, kelihatan seperti segi tiga terbalik. Betul-betul di tengah segi tiga terbalik itu tertulis Sanbi Castle, dalam fon besar. Dua puluh dua Pearl? Maksudnya jauh ke? Rasa jarak Harry hanyalah gerak hati semata-mata. “Haaa—Sinoi?”

23fa6eddd623.en: With a cutesy motion, Sora’s small hands handed a credit card–sized object towards Harry with his name on it.
23fa6eddd623.t: Dengan gerakan yang comel, tangan kecil Sora menghulurkan objek sebesar kad kredit kepada Harry dengan namanya di atasnya.

263d4947549c.en: “ARGGH!” Harry screamed in pain. The concoction now began to quickly spread and numb his gut as well. The concoction, at this point, had reached his lungs, diaphragm, and heart, forcing them to calm down, suffocating Harry from within as his wide-open mouth couldn’t draw as much oxygen as he desperately needed. His right arm was now wholly numb even though the pain was lingering there, but it now felt like it was happening outside his own body—like the pseudo pain you feel when you see someone else get badly hurt. A loud thought passed through his brain as if his instincts took the shape of another voice in his head: Hide! He slumped himself out of the bush, then wobbled his way forward as he began to lose the sensation of where his body ended and nature began. Striking a tree with his shoulder, he groaned, then slumped towards the ground behind it, resting on his side. With the last remnants of his will to control his numbing body, he covered his mouth with his mostly numb, somewhat responsive left hand to attempt to silence his anguished breath.
263d4947549c.t: “ARGGH!” Harry menjerit kesakitan. Campuran itu kini mula cepat merebak dan mengebaskan perutnya juga. Campuran itu, pada ketika ini, telah sampai ke paru-paru, diafragma dan jantungnya, memaksanya bertenang, melemaskan Harry dari dalam ketika mulutnya yang ternganga luas tidak dapat menyedut oksigen sebanyak yang amat diperlukannya. Lengan kanannya kini kebas sepenuhnya walaupun kesakitan masih berlegar di situ, tetapi kini ia terasa seperti berlaku di luar tubuhnya sendiri—seperti kesakitan palsu yang kau rasa apabila melihat orang lain cedera teruk. Satu fikiran kuat melintas di otaknya seolah-olah nalurinya mengambil bentuk suara lain dalam kepalanya: Sembunyi! Dia menggelongsor keluar dari semak, kemudian terhuyung-hayang ke depan ketika dia mula hilang sensasi di mana tubuhnya berakhir dan alam bermula. Merempuh sebatang pokok dengan bahunya, dia mengerang, kemudian rebah ke tanah di belakangnya, berbaring mengiring. Dengan sisa terakhir kemahuannya untuk mengawal tubuhnya yang semakin kebas, dia menekup mulutnya dengan tangan kirinya yang kebanyakannya kebas dan agak responsif untuk cuba mendiamkan nafasnya yang terseksa.

26867c01b10c.en: “I’SID’STA’I’RIDGE! I’NOT’PAYIN’A’SIN’BAL!” Sinoi blurted out loudly, spitting another blob from the corner of his mouth, and then lashed his reins, increasing the speed of the carriage. “I’ha’a’contrac’t’fill’too—” Sinoi blurted out loudly, with a rather saddening tone. The white sky gloom and the music were growing closer; the village outskirts were mere tens of seconds away.
26867c01b10c.t: “A’KA’DU’K’JE’DLM’KE’RA’! A’TAK’BA’YA’SA’BI’JI’BO’LA!” Sinoi terlepas cakap dengan kuat, meludahkan satu lagi gumpalan dari sudut mulutnya, dan kemudian melibas tali kekangnya, melajukan kereta itu. “A’pun’a’kon’trak’nak’pe’nuh’kan’ju—” Sinoi terlepas cakap dengan kuat, dengan nada yang agak menyedihkan. Cahaya putih samar di langit dan muzik semakin dekat; pinggir kampung hanya berpuluh saat lagi.

29dbd6132814.en: Strangers passed by, from Cruros to humans, Darfaries, to even Sorefaries. They all looked unique in their ways, with some being as much as eye candy like Sora, to others giving you a bad feeling from just crossing your eyes with them. Animals he had never seen or heard about before were either alive with people, being sliced apart, hanging from hooks, or being fried in parked wagons that were selling street food, competing with the restaurants for people’s hunger. The smells of the streets tickled his nose with a head-spinning amount of new things, from street food he had never tasted before to perfume. Amidst all those smells, something quite familiar rose above everything else—the smell of horse shit. Harry looked towards the ground, expecting to see horse shit staining everywhere, but found nothing. Where is that coming from? Another wave of the same rotten gaseous leafy smell came from a rustic-looking but not as worn-out carriage passing by. A heavy-looking bag underneath the bunghole of the passing egua looked like it was about to rip apart and splat shit everywhere.
29dbd6132814.t: Orang-orang asing lalu, dari Cruro hingga manusia, Darfaries, malah Sorefaries. Mereka semua kelihatan unik dengan cara masing-masing, dengan sesetengahnya sedap mata memandang seperti Sora, hingga yang lain memberi kau perasaan tidak enak hanya dengan bertentang mata dengan mereka. Haiwan-haiwan yang tidak pernah dilihat atau didengarinya sebelum ini sama ada hidup bersama orang, dihiris, tergantung pada cangkuk, atau digoreng di kereta kuda yang diletakkan menjual makanan jalanan, bersaing dengan restoran untuk kelaparan orang ramai. Bau-bau jalanan menggeletek hidungnya dengan jumlah benda baharu yang memeningkan kepala, dari makanan jalanan yang tidak pernah dirasanya hingga minyak wangi. Di tengah-tengah semua bau itu, sesuatu yang agak biasa naik mengatasi segala-galanya—bau tahi kuda. Harry memandang ke tanah, menjangkakan melihat tahi kuda mengotorkan merata tempat, tetapi tidak menemui apa-apa. Dari mana datangnya bau tu? Satu lagi gelombang bau berdaun bergas busuk yang sama datang dari sebuah kereta kuda yang kelihatan kampung tetapi tidak begitu usang yang lalu. Sebuah beg yang kelihatan berat di bawah lubang punggung egua yang lalu itu kelihatan seperti hendak koyak dan memercikkan tahi ke merata tempat.

2a31aab073ff.en: Harry couldn’t help himself but take another glance at her utterly waifu qualities. In the depths of his brain, the word simp flashed into existence.
2a31aab073ff.t: Harry tidak dapat menahan diri daripada mengerling sekali lagi sifat-sifat waifu-nya yang sempurna. Di kedalaman otaknya, perkataan simp muncul.

2b6d37e7db09.en: Just stay in ridge? Harry sat back, scratching his neck beard as he looked at the map. Ridge? I don’t see any stop by that name.
2b6d37e7db09.t: Duduk je dalam Kera? Harry bersandar semula, menggaru janggut lehernya sambil memandang peta. Kera? Aku tak nampak hentian nama tu pun.

2b86caa22067.en: With six shared wagon stops left behind him, Harry saw the sun getting ready to set. The feeling of discovery was still there, but not as strong as before. Harry’s lips longed for water; his stomach longed for sustenance; his bladder longed for relief; and his coccyx longed for a bed. Passing by a shared front yard of four houses, Harry heard a loud clash of wooden swords; three kids cheered on while another two battled. One of them stood his ground while the other came rushing towards him with an upward attack—Harry could almost see him and Maiara as kids doing the same thing too. Maiara’s uvula dangling as she grunted loudly, swinging her hammer at him, was still far too vivid in his memory. Pain and fear still lingered in his brain, but quirky happiness rose through them. Did I really grow up here like Eiri said?
2b86caa22067.t: Dengan enam hentian kereta kongsi ditinggalkan di belakangnya, Harry melihat matahari bersedia untuk terbenam. Perasaan penemuan masih ada, tetapi tidak sekuat tadi. Bibir Harry dahagakan air; perutnya dahagakan makanan; pundi kencingnya dahagakan kelegaan; dan tulang ekornya dahagakan katil. Melintasi halaman depan yang dikongsi empat buah rumah, Harry mendengar bunyi pedang kayu berlaga kuat; tiga kanak-kanak bersorak sementara dua lagi bertarung. Seorang daripada mereka bertahan sementara seorang lagi meluru ke arahnya dengan serangan ke atas—Harry hampir dapat melihat dirinya dan Maiara semasa kecil melakukan perkara yang sama. Anak tekak Maiara yang terjuntai ketika dia merengus kuat, menghayun tukulnya ke arahnya, masih terlalu jelas dalam ingatannya. Kesakitan dan ketakutan masih berlegar dalam otaknya, tetapi kegembiraan yang aneh timbul menembusinya. Aku betul-betul membesar kat sini macam yang Eiri cakap ke?

2c90de3b7b96.en: “But—but—what about—” The short double high-pitched call kept rubbing Harry’s conscience the wrong way.
2c90de3b7b96.t: “Tapi—tapi—macam mana dengan—” Panggilan berganda pendek bernada tinggi itu terus mengganggu hati nurani Harry.

2d6ca5e7c7a9.en: Itanema opened a drawer, grabbed long metal tongs, and started flipping over the meat cooking in the fireplace. The fire roared with each drip of meat juices as she turned them over, letting a meaty, smokey smell escape from the chimney and tantalize everyone in the room.
2d6ca5e7c7a9.t: Itanema membuka laci, mengambil penyepit logam panjang, dan mula membalikkan daging yang sedang dimasak di pendiang. Api mengaum dengan setiap titisan jus daging ketika dia membalikkannya, membiarkan bau daging berasap terlepas dari cerobong dan menggoda semua orang di dalam bilik.

2ddd1664c074.en: What did he say? Harry scooched forward on his seat and brought his head parallel to Sinoi’s. “I-I am sorry—Sinoi. Can you say it again?”
2ddd1664c074.t: Apa dia cakap? Harry mengesot ke depan di tempat duduknya dan membawa kepalanya selari dengan kepala Sinoi. “Sa-saya minta maaf—Sinoi. Boleh pak cik cakap lagi?”

2e26544ab740.en: The carriage continued, passing the shared wagon stop without signs of slowing down, and instead heading towards the dark forests at the end of the village. The music was loud, the booze flowed, the bonfire was hot, and sweaty big tits bounced around—it looked like nobody noticed or cared that a carriage was passing through. “Ahea’!” Sinoi blurted out, lashing the reins to force the egua straight into the darkness.
2e26544ab740.t: Kereta itu terus bergerak, melepasi hentian kereta kongsi tanpa tanda-tanda memperlahankan, sebaliknya menuju ke arah hutan gelap di hujung kampung. Muzik kuat, arak mengalir, unggun api panas, dan tetek besar yang berpeluh terlonjak-lonjak—nampaknya tiada siapa yang perasan atau peduli bahawa sebuah kereta sedang melintas. “De’pa’!” Sinoi terlepas cakap, melibas tali kekang untuk memaksa egua terus ke dalam kegelapan.

2ebbf76a3eee.en: Arukia bamboozled him at the last second, bringing the sandwich to her mouth instead. She then whipped her hand on Harry’s uniform and stood up to grab a glass of water by partially opening a handle attached to a large pipe on top of the sink. The usual angry gush of water didn’t seem as loud.
2ebbf76a3eee.t: Arukia memperdayakannya pada saat terakhir, membawa sandwic itu ke mulutnya sendiri sebaliknya. Dia kemudian mengesat tangannya pada pakaian seragam Harry dan berdiri untuk mengambil segelas air dengan membuka separuh pemegang yang dipasang pada paip besar di atas sinki. Curahan air marah yang biasa tidak kedengaran sekuat itu.

2ff97a3d25b0.en: The light from the fost lamp shooed away the encroaching darkness; Harry’s shoulder slumped slightly as his old carriage now felt like a haven against the forest’s darkness. Is that a shared wagon? Oh! It is! The passing-by wagon had Pamto’s Shared Wagon written on the side. Exchanging eyes with the passengers, his eyes were drawn particularly to a girl sleeping—or rather, passed out in the back by herself. Her black undershirt and leggings and white and pink unique clothing looked pretty worn, and they were all soaked in blood and mud stains. Her backpack and bow were resting by her feet and weren’t in good condition either. Harry felt a familiar sense out of her, but he couldn’t pinpoint where or when. He raised his hand towards her, but when he tried to raise his voice to her, the wagon had already passed by.
2ff97a3d25b0.t: Cahaya dari lampu fost itu menghalau kegelapan yang merapat; bahu Harry terlorot sedikit kerana kereta lamanya kini terasa seperti tempat perlindungan dari kegelapan hutan. Itu kereta kongsi ke? Oh! Memang ya! Kereta yang lalu itu tertulis Pamto’s Shared Wagon di sisinya. Bertukar pandangan dengan penumpang-penumpang, matanya tertarik khususnya kepada seorang gadis yang sedang tidur—atau lebih tepat, pengsan di belakang seorang diri. Baju dalam dan legging hitamnya serta pakaian putih dan merah jambu yang unik kelihatan agak lusuh, dan semuanya basah dengan kesan darah dan lumpur. Beg galas dan busurnya terletak di kakinya dan tidak dalam keadaan baik juga. Harry merasakan sesuatu yang biasa daripadanya, tetapi dia tidak dapat menentukan di mana atau bila. Dia mengangkat tangannya ke arahnya, tetapi apabila dia cuba meninggikan suara kepadanya, kereta itu sudah pun berlalu.

327933f296ef.en: What was that? Only the forest, its animals, and the egua neighs made a sound. The same odd short double high-pitched call echoed in the woods again, making the hair on Harry’s back rise. The thought of stepping out of the carriage made his feet hesitate, but his bladder was on its limits. The tree’s leaves seemed to mock him from the shadows cast by the fost lamp in the carriage. “But—leave my bag here?”
327933f296ef.t: Apa tu? Hanya hutan, haiwan-haiwannya, dan ringkikan egua yang berbunyi. Panggilan berganda pendek bernada tinggi yang ganjil itu bergema lagi di hutan, membuatkan bulu roma di belakang Harry meremang. Fikiran untuk melangkah keluar dari kereta membuatkan kakinya teragak-agak, tetapi pundi kencingnya sudah di hadnya. Daun-daun pokok seakan-akan mengejeknya dari bayang-bayang yang dihasilkan oleh lampu fost di kereta. “Tapi—tinggal beg saya kat sini?”

33624db12067.en: “BY THE ORDER OF EIRI SANBI ROYAL, OPEN THE DOOR!” Eiri spoke loudly at the gate, and sure enough, the familiar sounds of screaming hinges began as large, heavy doors creaked open towards them.
33624db12067.t: “DENGAN PERINTAH EIRI SANBI ROYAL, BUKA PINTU!” Eiri bercakap dengan kuat di pintu gerbang, dan memang, bunyi engsel menjerit yang biasa bermula ketika pintu besar yang berat itu berkeriut terbuka ke arah mereka.

33d9b3d502df.en: Sinoi let out a long, tired, loud exhale—like someone would if their boss suddenly asked to stay overtime on a Friday night. “Che’ya’map” He spoke louder but just as mumbled as usual.
33d9b3d502df.t: Sinoi menghembus nafas panjang, letih dan kuat—seperti yang dilakukan seseorang jika bosnya tiba-tiba meminta kerja lebih masa pada malam Jumaat. “Te’pe’ta’” Dia bercakap lebih kuat tetapi sama bergumam seperti biasa.

3456eb7c70be.en: Harry looked behind the kids playing some sort of duel. Not far from them, three ladies talked amongst themselves under a bright fost lamp, while a guy not far from them brought another lamp to life—similar to what Sora showed to Harry. By him, two other guys seemed very busy drinking and chatting away, roasting a nice hunk of meat. One of them raised his mug towards Harry, and he waved back. With the smell of sizzling skin spreading through the air far and wide, Harry imagined himself sitting alongside them, wetting his lips on beer and helping them utterly destroy that barbeque with his salivating teeth.
3456eb7c70be.t: Harry memandang di belakang kanak-kanak yang bermain sejenis pertarungan. Tidak jauh dari mereka, tiga wanita berbual sesama sendiri di bawah lampu fost yang terang, manakala seorang lelaki tidak jauh dari mereka menghidupkan sebuah lagi lampu—serupa dengan apa yang Sora tunjukkan kepada Harry. Di sebelahnya, dua lelaki lain kelihatan sangat sibuk minum dan berbual, memanggang seketul daging yang sedap. Salah seorang daripada mereka mengangkat kolenya ke arah Harry, dan dia melambai balik. Dengan bau kulit yang berdesir merebak ke udara jauh dan luas, Harry membayangkan dirinya duduk bersama mereka, membasahkan bibirnya dengan bir dan membantu mereka memusnahkan barbeku itu dengan giginya yang berair.

3457f83a2b23.en: “Not even a guess?” Arukia retracted away from Harry with a snappy tone. Looking towards Itanema with a smug chin up, she asked tightly, “Do you even know?”
3457f83a2b23.t: “Teka pun tak?” Arukia menarik diri dari Harry dengan nada tajam. Memandang ke arah Itanema dengan dagu terangkat yang angkuh, dia bertanya dengan tegang, “Kau tahu ke?”

372bf2ec02da.en: “Are you riding all the way to Fishing Tree? Can we stop at The Dead Wozen? I—isn’t the forest dangerous?” Harry scooched forward to listen to Sinoi’s babblings.
372bf2ec02da.t: “Pak cik naik sampai ke Fishing Tree ke? Boleh kita berhenti kat The Dead Wozen? Sa—saya ingat hutan bahaya?” Harry mengesot ke depan untuk mendengar celoteh Sinoi.

38be0feda423.en: Gulping, Harry looked away, his cheeks reddening. What do I do now? I have no idea.
38be0feda423.t: Menelan liur, Harry mengalihkan pandangan, pipinya memerah. Apa aku nak buat sekarang? Aku langsung tak tahu.

3abc2b99c08b.en: “I’wil’rop’y’off’fath’awa’—jus’lax’” Another mumble of words came out of Sinoi’s mouth, barely breaking above the rustling noises of this vibrant kingdom.
3abc2b99c08b.t: “A’tur’kan’kau’jau’sik’—rile’aj’” Satu lagi gumaman kata-kata keluar dari mulut Sinoi, hampir tidak menembusi riuh-rendah kerajaan yang meriah ini.

3bc6b3630d04.en: “I’shor’bit!’” Sinoi curtly replied as he guided the egua left on a split on the road, leaving the echoes of the live band behind.
3bc6b3630d04.t: “Se’ke’je’!’” Sinoi menjawab ringkas sambil memandu egua ke kiri di persimpangan jalan, meninggalkan gema kumpulan muzik secara langsung di belakang.

3eb683c32c59.en: Arukia looked through a window hole in the swinging door, then a sassiness rushed through her voice towards Harry, “Why are we wasting money on you? I can’t believe why the monarchy department agreed with Maiara’s stupid request!” She looked at Itanema, apparently waiting for her to pitch in.
3eb683c32c59.t: Arukia memandang melalui lubang tingkap di pintu ayun, kemudian kekurangajaran menerpa dalam suaranya ke arah Harry, “Kenapa kita membazir duit untuk kau? Aku tak percaya kenapa jabatan monarki setuju dengan permintaan bodoh Maiara!” Dia memandang Itanema, nampaknya menunggu dia menyampuk.

4000506d113e.en: “Ya’lots’mud. G’pee!” Sinoi pointed backward. “G’G’it!” Sinoi made a higher-pitched squeal. “G’pee’in’th’woods!” He moved his hand outwards with an energy never seen before—at least for Sinoi. “W’can’t’b’stop’fo’too’lon’.” He said more in this short span of time than the entire afternoon.
4000506d113e.t: “Ba’nyak’lum’pur. Pi’ken’cing!” Sinoi menunjuk ke belakang. “Pi’Pi’ce’pat!” Sinoi membuat jeritan bernada lebih tinggi. “Pi’ken’cing’dlm’hu’tan!” Dia menggerakkan tangannya ke luar dengan tenaga yang tidak pernah dilihat sebelum ini—sekurang-kurangnya bagi Sinoi. “Ta’bo’le’ber’hen’ti’la’ma’.” Dia bercakap lebih banyak dalam masa singkat ini berbanding sepanjang petang.

42a48cf5464a.en: Harry kept looking around, noticing so many new things, but one thing in particular called to his attention. It was a group of Cruros seated at a table outside a bar, writing stuff in their journals and showing it to one another. The map! Harry pulled out a pamphlet from the bag. Its thick rough paper felt almost like sandpaper, with whatever was written or drawn on it leaving textured grooves—like holding a used carbon copy paper. Carefully unfolding, Harry saw Sanbi Kingdom Shared Wagon Routes written up top, with black inkings of what appeared to be a bunch of interconnecting dots in the roads and rivers with names, prices, and schedules. The whole thing felt familiar—yeah, this is the same Sanbi Kingdom map I saw before! But bigger? Wait—is this a bus route map of the kingdom? Wait! What’s a bus? Harry felt something come to mind. It was large, and it could fit a lot of people. Pretty boxy in shape, rectangular too—rubber wheels! Yeah— Harry looked at all the passing-by carriages and noticed some of them had something blackish akin to rubber, but it was just a thick strip at the end of wood or metal wheels. Did they look like that? I thought it was smaller and the whole thing was covered in rubber—
42a48cf5464a.t: Harry terus memandang sekeliling, perasan begitu banyak benda baharu, tetapi satu perkara khususnya menarik perhatiannya. Ia sekumpulan Cruro yang duduk di meja di luar sebuah bar, menulis sesuatu dalam jurnal mereka dan menunjukkannya antara satu sama lain. Peta! Harry mengeluarkan risalah dari beg. Kertasnya yang tebal dan kasar terasa hampir seperti kertas pasir, dengan apa sahaja yang ditulis atau dilukis padanya meninggalkan alur bertekstur—seperti memegang kertas karbon terpakai. Dengan berhati-hati membukanya, Harry nampak Sanbi Kingdom Shared Wagon Routes tertulis di atas, dengan lakaran dakwat hitam yang kelihatan seperti sekumpulan titik yang bersambung di jalan dan sungai dengan nama, harga dan jadual. Semuanya terasa biasa—ha, ni peta Kerajaan Sanbi yang sama yang aku nampak dulu! Tapi lebih besar? Kejap—ni peta laluan bas kerajaan ke? Kejap! Apa itu bas? Harry merasakan sesuatu terlintas di fikiran. Ia besar, dan boleh memuatkan ramai orang. Agak berbentuk kotak, segi empat tepat juga—roda getah! Ha— Harry memandang semua kereta kuda yang lalu dan perasan sesetengahnya mempunyai sesuatu yang kehitaman seperti getah, tetapi ia hanya jalur tebal di hujung roda kayu atau logam. Macam tu ke rupanya? Aku ingat ia lebih kecil dan seluruhnya dibalut getah—

43b6e0ea337a.en: “Ya—ya—ya—thirty-seven will erase it anyways!” A girly voice stated in a dismissive tone as a sharp metallic bang went off right in front of Harry, piercing itself deep in his trachea.
43b6e0ea337a.t: “Ye—ye—ye—tiga puluh tujuh akan padamkan semua tu juga!” Suara gadis menyatakan dengan nada meremehkan ketika dentuman logam tajam berbunyi betul-betul di hadapan Harry, menembusi jauh ke dalam trakeanya.

486fc25fbd57.en: While he walked to where she pointed, butterflies flew in Harry’s growling stomach as he saw a familiar face averting her timid eyes away from him.
486fc25fbd57.t: Sambil dia berjalan ke tempat yang ditunjukkannya, rama-rama berterbangan dalam perut Harry yang berkeroncong ketika dia melihat wajah yang dikenali mengalihkan matanya yang malu-malu darinya.

49f639e406d6.en: “Next one—your final chance.” Arukia lowered her voice, and now a promiscuous tone took over as she bit her lips. It seemed like she was ready to crank up the heat. “I’ll even let you squeeze it if you get this right—what are the three departments of Sanbi kingdom?”
49f639e406d6.t: “Soalan seterusnya—peluang terakhir kau.” Arukia merendahkan suaranya, dan kini nada menggoda mengambil alih sambil dia menggigit bibirnya. Dia kelihatan bersedia untuk memanaskan suasana. “Aku siap biar kau picit kalau kau jawab betul—apakah tiga jabatan kerajaan Sanbi?”

4a20a113ee6d.en: “Ah’wi’do!” Sinoi replied, but his words did not reach Eiri—heck, they barely reached Harry’s ears. With a lazy pull of the egua reins, the wagon creaked as the egua began trotting with the same laziness as its owner.
4a20a113ee6d.t: “A’bu’!” Sinoi menjawab, tetapi kata-katanya tidak sampai kepada Eiri—malah, ia hampir tidak sampai ke telinga Harry. Dengan tarikan malas pada tali kekang egua, kereta itu berkeriut ketika egua mula berlari anak dengan kemalasan yang sama seperti pemiliknya.

4a610794ee65.en: Excitement and anxiety are born from the same root: wanting to see the future, and for Harry, that future was right now. The familiar feeling of drinking a gallon of coffee was there, but somehow he didn’t seem to hate this feeling in his chest this time entirely—if that was even the same feeling he had felt before. Perhaps it didn’t feel bad this time as he was doing something about it, as in looking around and absorbing as many details as possible of this new place he now had to call home, or that was his home, to begin with, and he just couldn’t remember.
4a610794ee65.t: Keterujaan dan keresahan lahir dari akar yang sama: mahu melihat masa depan, dan bagi Harry, masa depan itu adalah sekarang. Perasaan biasa seperti minum segelen kopi ada di situ, tetapi entah bagaimana dia tidak kelihatan membenci perasaan di dadanya ini sepenuhnya kali ini—kalau itu pun perasaan yang sama yang pernah dirasainya sebelum ini. Mungkin ia tidak terasa buruk kali ini kerana dia sedang melakukan sesuatu mengenainya, iaitu memandang sekeliling dan menyerap seberapa banyak butiran tempat baharu yang kini terpaksa dipanggilnya rumah, atau yang memang rumahnya sejak awal, cuma dia tidak dapat mengingatinya.

50747893ff7e.en: Jumping at Eiri’s voice, Harry turned around. “Sorry! I—ehh—was just looking at the meat!” he said, smiling like a child caught with his hand in the cookie jar.
50747893ff7e.t: Terkejut mendengar suara Eiri, Harry berpaling. “Maaf! Saya—ehh—cuma tengok daging tu!” katanya, tersenyum seperti budak yang tertangkap dengan tangan dalam balang biskut.

5106ab147d33.en: Harry waved goodbye to Sora and Eiri, seeing them grow smaller with each constant lazy trot against the rocky road that shook the carriage. The massive Sanbi Castle gates grew smaller and soon vanished from Harry’s sight. The only sight left of familiarity was the Sanbi castle’s round wall as the egua kept trotting on the road around it.
5106ab147d33.t: Harry melambai selamat tinggal kepada Sora dan Eiri, melihat mereka semakin kecil dengan setiap lari anak malas yang berterusan di atas jalan berbatu yang menggegarkan kereta. Pintu gerbang Istana Sanbi yang besar semakin mengecil dan tidak lama kemudian hilang dari pandangan Harry. Satu-satunya pemandangan biasa yang tinggal ialah tembok bulat istana Sanbi ketika egua terus berlari anak di jalan yang mengelilinginya.

583c5bdc6baf.en: Still chewing the monstrous bite behind her hand, Arukia shook her head. She snapped her fingers towards Itanema, but she didn’t seem to get a reply. With a nice gulp and a pinched expression, Arukia spoke up to the other maid, “Itanema?”
583c5bdc6baf.t: Masih mengunyah gigitan besar itu di sebalik tangannya, Arukia menggeleng. Dia memetik jarinya ke arah Itanema, tetapi nampaknya tidak mendapat jawapan. Dengan telanan yang sedap dan riak yang terhimpit, Arukia bersuara kepada pembantu rumah yang lagi satu, “Itanema?”

5b41beceaba5.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 1: a brown-haired woman offers Harry a bite of food in a kitchen with hanging pots.
5b41beceaba5.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 1: seorang wanita berambut coklat menawarkan sesuap makanan kepada Harry di dapur dengan periuk-periuk tergantung.

5c919fe452ad.en: The carriage now began leaving the large castle walls behind. Marching to the East.
5c919fe452ad.t: Kereta itu kini mula meninggalkan tembok istana yang besar. Mara ke Timur.

5d3df23978ab.en: “The king and queen of Sanbi, Itagiba Sanbi Royal and Neferteri Sanbi Royal.” Itanema once again replied from the tip of her tongue as she kept brooming—one could even think the spontaneous game show was rigged.
5d3df23978ab.t: “Raja dan permaisuri Sanbi, Itagiba Sanbi Royal dan Neferteri Sanbi Royal.” Itanema sekali lagi menjawab dari hujung lidahnya sambil terus menyapu—orang mungkin malah menyangka rancangan kuiz spontan itu telah diatur.

607c6a01ed91.en: Itanema sucked on her blistered fingers of one hand for a hot second, taking them out when they healed completely. She then devoted herself back to the fireplace, grabbing a boiling sausage from the flames and taking a bite. Boiling steam came out of her mouth like she was puffing out a cigar, but she seemed pretty intent on eating it. Not even a single tear came out of her eyes; her face looked in some trance, or a pain-induced meditation, not far from the people who do body suspension.
607c6a01ed91.t: Itanema menghisap jari yang melepuh di sebelah tangannya sekejap, mengeluarkannya apabila ia sembuh sepenuhnya. Dia kemudian menumpukan dirinya semula kepada pendiang, mengambil sebatang sosej yang mendidih dari api dan menggigitnya. Wap mendidih keluar dari mulutnya seperti dia menghembus asap cerut, tetapi dia kelihatan agak bertekad untuk memakannya. Tiada setitis pun air mata keluar dari matanya; wajahnya kelihatan dalam keadaan khayal, atau meditasi akibat kesakitan, tidak jauh berbeza dengan orang yang melakukan penggantungan badan.

63bed38cff18.en: Harry laughed with a bright smile alongside the cheery villagers’ shouts as the banjo player went off on a drunk solo—perhaps for just a moment, he felt as if he really had grown up in a Sanbi village somewhere, or perhaps he wished it. As the carriage kept chugging along the main road, he placed his hand over his belly to appease his aching bladder, also noticing something by the side of the road after the bonfire. There were a few empty benches against the wall of a store, while above it, the words The Dead Wozen Village Bar was painted up on the wall, lit up by two nearby fost stone lamps trying to compensate for the faded paint and moss growing in the building*.* I guessed right! Harry had built a solid mental map of the shared stops to Fishing Tree. This stop was on the easternmost edge of the Sanbi kingdom’s downward triangular shape, one stop away from what had to be a boat transfer due to a river.
63bed38cff18.t: Harry ketawa dengan senyuman lebar bersama jeritan ceria penduduk kampung ketika pemain banjo memulakan solo mabuk—mungkin hanya untuk seketika, dia merasa seolah-olah dia benar-benar membesar di sebuah kampung Sanbi di suatu tempat, atau mungkin dia mengharapkannya. Ketika kereta itu terus bergerak di sepanjang jalan utama, dia meletakkan tangannya di atas perutnya untuk menenangkan pundi kencingnya yang sakit, turut perasan sesuatu di tepi jalan selepas unggun api. Ada beberapa bangku kosong di dinding sebuah kedai, manakala di atasnya, perkataan The Dead Wozen Village Bar dicat di dinding, diterangi oleh dua lampu fost stone berdekatan yang cuba mengimbangi cat yang pudar dan lumut yang tumbuh di bangunan itu*.* Tekaan aku betul! Harry telah membina peta mental yang kukuh tentang hentian-hentian kereta kongsi ke Fishing Tree. Hentian ini berada di pinggir paling timur bentuk segi tiga terbalik kerajaan Sanbi, satu hentian dari apa yang pasti pertukaran ke bot kerana sebatang sungai.

650266e45a60.en: His brain could not believe what his eyes were seeing. What was supposed to be a glance from Harry turned out to be an open stare. “You—you okay?” he spoke softly; part of him didn’t want to disturb whatever she was doing.
650266e45a60.t: Otaknya tidak dapat mempercayai apa yang dilihat matanya. Apa yang sepatutnya hanya kerlingan daripada Harry bertukar menjadi renungan terang-terangan. “Awak—awak okey?” dia bercakap perlahan; sebahagian dirinya tidak mahu mengganggu apa pun yang sedang dilakukannya.

650ff2b83597.en: Another wave of sensation began emanating from the same tip lodged inside Harry, but this time it was numbness followed by a paralyzing feeling. Harry’s mind threw a master warning alert as the vivid memory of when something nasty was injected into his neck came to the forefront of his mind. The numbness is the same! Shit! Without thinking, he grabbed the lodged arrow and tried to pull it out with all the strength he had left. “AHHH!” Harry screamed in pain as the arrow got partly out before snapping in the middle. The tip of the arrow was still lodged in his flesh, still releasing whatever nasty concoction it contained. He took off, running deeper into the forest with his left hand, trying to feel ahead, but then he struck what had to be a large root and fell forward onto a bush.
650ff2b83597.t: Satu lagi gelombang sensasi mula terpancar dari hujung yang sama yang tertancap di dalam Harry, tetapi kali ini kebas diikuti perasaan lumpuh. Fikiran Harry melontarkan amaran amaran utama ketika ingatan jelas tentang ketika sesuatu yang jahat disuntik ke dalam lehernya muncul di barisan hadapan fikirannya. Kebas ni sama! Sial! Tanpa berfikir, dia memegang anak panah yang tertancap itu dan cuba mencabutnya dengan sepenuh kekuatan yang masih ada. “AHHH!” Harry menjerit kesakitan ketika anak panah itu keluar sebahagian sebelum patah di tengah. Hujung anak panah itu masih tertancap dalam dagingnya, masih melepaskan apa pun campuran jahat yang terkandung di dalamnya. Dia meluru, berlari lebih dalam ke hutan dengan tangan kirinya, cuba meraba ke depan, tetapi kemudian dia terlanggar sesuatu yang pasti akar besar dan jatuh tersembam ke atas semak.

66832c38f410.en: “I’dro’y’off’share’wago. Ya’go’fishi’tre—” Sinoi coughed like he had lung cancer, then spit another blob from the corner of his mouth. His eyes didn’t seem open at all—maybe the egua was controlling the whole thing after all?
66832c38f410.t: “A’tur’kan’kau’kat’ke’kong’si. Kau’pi’Fishi’Tre—” Sinoi terbatuk seperti dia menghidap barah paru-paru, kemudian meludahkan satu lagi gumpalan dari sudut mulutnya. Matanya tidak kelihatan terbuka langsung—mungkin egua itu yang mengawal semuanya rupanya?

6ab353927c62.en: Harry looked at the passing ground; if he were to jump off right now, it would probably hurt a lot. Inside his mind, a vision of him getting closer to the edge, pulling his dong out, and letting it rain in the wind seemed plausible. As he scooched closer to the edge to make that a reality, the ground rushing by beneath him and the unsteadiness of the carriage made that nearly impossible.
6ab353927c62.t: Harry memandang tanah yang berlalu; jika dia melompat sekarang, mungkin ia akan sangat menyakitkan. Dalam fikirannya, bayangan dirinya mendekati tepi, mengeluarkan koneknya, dan membiarkannya menghujan ditiup angin kelihatan munasabah. Ketika dia mengesot mendekati tepi untuk merealisasikannya, tanah yang meluru di bawahnya dan ketidakstabilan kereta itu menjadikannya hampir mustahil.

6ae654f9786c.en: Sinoi was reactionless to it—perhaps some folk stop giving shits to the fact that soul death is coming sooner rather than later for them. Suddenly, a short double high-pitched call echoed from the forest as they rode on that dark road. Coincidentally, Sinoi began slowing down to a stop, yelling out, “L’ve’bag’er’n’G’pee!”
6ae654f9786c.t: Sinoi tanpa reaksi terhadapnya—mungkin sesetengah orang berhenti peduli tentang hakikat bahawa mati jiwa akan datang lebih cepat daripada lambat bagi mereka. Tiba-tiba, panggilan berganda pendek bernada tinggi bergema dari hutan ketika mereka menunggang di jalan gelap itu. Secara kebetulan, Sinoi mula memperlahankan sehingga berhenti, menjerit, “Ting’beg’n’Pi’ken’cing!”

6da9afb7d54b.en: A sharp metallic bang on wood sounded off from deeper in the forest on the other side of the road. A whooshing sound flew by Harry, striking the tree he was resting against. His hand perused where the noise occurred and felt a long, thin, smooth stick by his head. Feather? An arrow?
6da9afb7d54b.t: Dentuman logam yang tajam pada kayu kedengaran dari lebih dalam di hutan di seberang jalan. Bunyi desiran terbang melepasi Harry, menghentam pokok tempat dia bersandar. Tangannya meraba tempat bunyi itu berlaku dan merasakan sebatang kayu yang panjang, nipis dan licin di tepi kepalanya. Bulu? Anak panah?

6f71591d2db2.en: Itanema, still silent, finished brooming the dirt to a pan, then threw it in the fire—rather than the trash.
6f71591d2db2.t: Itanema, masih diam, selesai menyapu habuk ke penyodok, kemudian mencampakkannya ke dalam api—bukannya tong sampah.

723af7bd70a9.en: “Get’in.” A jumble of tired words came out of Sinoi’s mouth as he kept on chewing on a wooden stick.
723af7bd70a9.t: “Nai’.” Gumpalan kata-kata yang letih keluar dari mulut Sinoi sambil dia terus mengunyah sebatang kayu.

729682feb6e4.en: A splat sound, one of a leash hitting an animal’s tough hide, cut through the forest noises.
729682feb6e4.t: Bunyi libasan, bunyi tali kekang mengenai kulit tebal seekor haiwan, memotong bunyi hutan.

743fb1375378.en: Clearing his throat with a deep cough that sounded like he was coughing up his lungs, Sinoi spat a brownish substance from the corner of his mouth onto the moving ground that looked like a murderous blob, viciously wanting to swallow people. His chewing stick then started to move about his mouth as he chewed on it like a horse would chew hard candy. “I’will’dropya’off’fathe’away’—jus’relax’”
743fb1375378.t: Berdehem dengan batuk dalam yang kedengaran seperti dia membatukkan paru-parunya, Sinoi meludahkan bahan keperangan dari sudut mulutnya ke tanah yang bergerak yang kelihatan seperti gumpalan pembunuh, yang dengan ganas mahu menelan orang. Kayu kunyahnya kemudian mula bergerak di dalam mulutnya sambil dia mengunyahnya seperti kuda mengunyah gula-gula keras. “A’kan’turun’kan’kau’jauh’sikit’—rilek’aje’”

78f868b7d2f8.en: His stomach revolted at Arukia’s fuckery, growling at only getting back barely a piece left, with her girly perfume still wrecking the taste. Still, better than having nothing left. Harry then noticed the red lip mark she left on it—subconsciously, he wondered if the sandwich would taste any different as it neared his salivating mouth.
78f868b7d2f8.t: Perutnya memberontak dengan kenakalan celaka Arukia, berkeroncong kerana hanya mendapat kembali sekeping kecil, dengan minyak wangi keanak-gadisannya masih merosakkan rasa. Tetap juga, lebih baik daripada tiada langsung. Harry kemudian perasan kesan bibir merah yang ditinggalkannya padanya—tanpa sedar, dia tertanya-tanya sama ada sandwic itu akan terasa berbeza ketika ia semakin hampir ke mulutnya yang berair.

7909c2565317.en: I-I guess so. Harry felt his bladder muscles about to rip, giving him no choice. He looked at the supposed muddy ground, but it didn’t seem too bad. Slowly stepping out of the carriage, his boots didn’t make the squishing sound he had presumed. He looked back at his bag in the dry carriage as his mind told him to pick it up. But what if I do lose it in the dark? The same ominous wired feeling lingered in his brain and chest, but his bladder overrode his inaction. With one careful step after another, he approached the vegetation on the side of the road and pulled out his junk, wetted from slightly pissing himself beforehand. Apparently, holding it in for so long made his bladder seem stuck at first, but with enough pressure, a torrential stream came out of his body; the overwhelming relief sensation spreading through his lower body was so good that he couldn’t stop himself from letting out a moan. Finally—
7909c2565317.t: Ra-rasanya macam tu la. Harry merasakan otot pundi kencingnya hendak koyak, tidak memberinya pilihan. Dia memandang tanah yang disangka berlumpur, tetapi ia tidak kelihatan teruk sangat. Perlahan-lahan melangkah keluar dari kereta, butnya tidak mengeluarkan bunyi lecak yang disangkanya. Dia menoleh ke arah begnya di dalam kereta yang kering sementara fikirannya menyuruhnya mengambilnya. Tapi macam mana kalau aku hilangkan dalam gelap? Perasaan teruja yang tidak menyenangkan yang sama berlegar dalam otak dan dadanya, tetapi pundi kencingnya mengatasi ketidaktindakannya. Dengan satu langkah berhati-hati demi satu langkah, dia mendekati tumbuh-tumbuhan di tepi jalan dan mengeluarkan anunya, yang basah kerana sedikit terkencing sebelum itu. Nampaknya, menahannya terlalu lama membuatkan pundi kencingnya kelihatan tersekat pada mulanya, tetapi dengan tekanan yang cukup, aliran deras keluar dari tubuhnya; sensasi kelegaan yang amat sangat merebak ke seluruh bahagian bawah tubuhnya begitu nikmat sehingga dia tidak dapat menahan diri daripada mengerang. Akhirnya—

7afa45d5706c.en: The carriage kept moving along this darkening rough road, leaving the cluster of houses behind. Another carriage not far ahead coming in the opposite direction had a fost lamp on both front and back, illuminating the road brightly against the setting sun. It was larger than most carriages, with four eguas trotting pulling its chunky weight. It had many seats inside with extra ones on the ceiling, but there weren’t many people. Sinoi made a hustling noise as his hands dug deep into a pocket, taking out what appeared to be a wooden container about the size of a lighter. With a slight clicking noise, he slid his hand vertically on the side wooden gear to unlock the top, then slid the top to the side. He dumped what had to be salt from that contraption into a fost lamp by his feet, making it come alive too, and placing it by his side.
7afa45d5706c.t: Kereta itu terus bergerak di sepanjang jalan kasar yang semakin gelap ini, meninggalkan kelompok rumah di belakang. Sebuah lagi kereta tidak jauh di depan yang datang dari arah bertentangan mempunyai lampu fost di depan dan belakang, menerangi jalan dengan terang melawan matahari yang terbenam. Ia lebih besar daripada kebanyakan kereta kuda, dengan empat ekor egua berlari anak menarik beratnya yang besar. Ia mempunyai banyak tempat duduk di dalam dengan tempat duduk tambahan di bumbung, tetapi tidak ramai orang. Sinoi membuat bunyi tergesa-gesa sambil tangannya menyeluk dalam ke dalam poket, mengeluarkan sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti bekas kayu kira-kira sebesar pemetik api. Dengan bunyi klik yang perlahan, dia menggelongsor tangannya secara menegak pada gear kayu di sisi untuk membuka kunci bahagian atas, kemudian menggelongsor bahagian atas ke tepi. Dia menuang sesuatu yang pasti garam dari alat itu ke dalam lampu fost di kakinya, menghidupkannya juga, dan meletakkannya di sisinya.

7d31d5dea2ac.en: “What? I’m not the one in the wrong here. We could have gotten a raise instead of this useless guy being pandered!” Arukia, resting against the door, twirled her hair. With an annoyed sigh, she pulled the clothing covering her breasts slightly towards Harry—more teasing than revealing. “Next time, the questions will be tougher, so come prepared!” She disappeared towards the atrium.
7d31d5dea2ac.t: “Apa? Bukan aku yang salah kat sini. Kita boleh dapat kenaikan gaji dan bukannya mamat tak berguna ni yang dimanjakan!” Arukia, bersandar pada pintu, memintal rambutnya. Dengan keluhan jengkel, dia menarik pakaian yang menutupi buah dadanya sedikit ke arah Harry—lebih mengusik daripada mendedahkan. “Lain kali, soalan akan lebih susah, jadi datang dengan persediaan!” Dia hilang ke arah atrium.

7d961ed8bc3e.en: Hugging Sora from the side, Eiri patted her head and spoke with a motherly tone, “That’s new coming from you—but you could have just said no to Harry instead of all of that. He won’t bite, right, Harry?”
7d961ed8bc3e.t: Memeluk Sora dari sisi, Eiri menepuk kepalanya dan bercakap dengan nada keibuan, “Itu baru dengar dari kau—tapi kau boleh je cakap tak kat Harry dan bukannya semua tu. Dia takkan gigit, kan, Harry?”

7ee8fd3376fb.en: “Thanks—ah, Sinoi.” Harry let out a constrained grunt as the egua’s canter made the carriage shake even more. Clenching his face as his bladder pinched with each bump, he tried to focus away from it by focusing on the village coming into sight ahead.
7ee8fd3376fb.t: “Terima kasih—ah, Sinoi.” Harry mengeluarkan rengusan yang tertahan ketika lari egua membuatkan kereta itu bergegar lebih kuat. Mengerutkan mukanya sementara pundi kencingnya dicubit dengan setiap hentakan, dia cuba mengalihkan tumpuan darinya dengan menumpukan perhatian pada kampung yang mula kelihatan di depan.

7ef609cc264f.en: Staring at his badge and seeing his name written near the glimmering thermometer-like apparatus when he touched his thumb on its base, Harry felt a sense of realness strike him. He looked back, hoping to see Eiri and Sora still, but it was for naught as he was already far away. The buildings looked different, but not too different from the ones in front of the castle door. Harry glanced at the signs and noticed some didn’t even have names written but just a logogram of what it was about. A mug of beer with a hearty-looking drumstick was carved in one of them. Tavern? OH! This one is a nari gel place? Harry saw another wooden carved sign, but this time it was a nari gel glass container, including a metal cast writing Manana’s Nari Shop into the cork—giving the sign a fancy-like vibe. Below it was an open door where he could peek inside for a second, seeing a wall of nari gels with various colors and things inside.
7ef609cc264f.t: Merenung lencananya dan melihat namanya tertulis berhampiran alat seperti termometer yang berkilauan apabila dia menyentuhkan ibu jarinya pada pangkalnya, Harry merasakan rasa nyata menyerangnya. Dia menoleh, berharap masih dapat melihat Eiri dan Sora, tetapi sia-sia kerana dia sudah jauh. Bangunan-bangunan kelihatan berbeza, tetapi tidak terlalu berbeza dari yang di hadapan pintu istana. Harry mengerling papan-papan tanda dan perasan sesetengahnya tidak bertulis nama pun tetapi hanya logogram tentang apa ia. Sebiji kole bir dengan peha ayam yang kelihatan lazat diukir pada salah satunya. Kedai minum? OH! Yang ni kedai nari gel ke? Harry nampak satu lagi papan tanda kayu berukir, tetapi kali ini bekas kaca nari gel, termasuk tulisan logam tuang Manana’s Nari Shop pada gabusnya—memberikan papan tanda itu aura yang mewah. Di bawahnya ada pintu terbuka di mana dia dapat mengintai ke dalam sesaat, melihat dinding nari gel dengan pelbagai warna dan benda di dalamnya.

7fd96b3a6b62.en: Winga mail—Hiromi! Harry smiled, making a higher-pitched agreement hum. “I forgot to ask Hiromi about it! He mentioned he would write to me too! Can I ask how to do it?”
7fd96b3a6b62.t: Winga mail—Hiromi! Harry tersenyum, membuat dengungan bersetuju yang bernada lebih tinggi. “Saya terlupa nak tanya Hiromi pasal tu! Dia ada sebut dia akan tulis kat saya juga! Boleh saya tanya macam mana nak buat?”

81ccb0c3d909.en: Harry scratched his head as another embarrassed laugh came out of him. Wait—so that was a rejection too? I guess I’m getting used to it now. Harry took a deep breath of the outside air, arriving at a familiar tall door with a large jumping Sanbi fish carved and painted on it—that massive door was the only way in or out of the round walls encircling the castle grounds. A flashback passed through his mind as he stood in the same spot where Kibe handed over his badge. “Eiri—can I ask about my badge?”
81ccb0c3d909.t: Harry menggaru kepalanya sambil satu lagi ketawa malu keluar daripadanya. Kejap—jadi itu penolakan juga? Rasanya aku dah mula biasa sekarang. Harry menarik nafas dalam udara luar, tiba di pintu tinggi yang biasa dengan ikan Sanbi melompat yang besar diukir dan dicat padanya—pintu besar itu satu-satunya jalan masuk atau keluar dari tembok bulat yang mengelilingi kawasan istana. Satu imbasan melintas di fikirannya ketika dia berdiri di tempat yang sama di mana Kibe menyerahkan lencananya. “Eiri—boleh saya tanya pasal lencana saya?”

83852785a632.en: Sora grabbed the side of her long black and blue skirt. Her rosacea grew intense as her wavering eyes had something to say, but her tiny mouth seemed inept. Deeply bowing, it looked like she was on the verge of booking it at full speed back towards the castle, but perhaps being by Eiri gave her the courage, or outright convinced her beforehand, to remain close to Harry’s hungering eyes.
83852785a632.t: Sora memegang sisi skirt hitam dan biru panjangnya. Rosaseanya menjadi semakin ketara sementara matanya yang goyah mempunyai sesuatu untuk dikatakan, tetapi mulut kecilnya kelihatan tidak berdaya. Menunduk dalam-dalam, dia kelihatan di ambang hendak lari sepantas kilat kembali ke istana, tetapi mungkin berada di sebelah Eiri memberinya keberanian, atau sudah meyakinkannya terlebih dahulu, untuk kekal dekat dengan mata Harry yang lapar.

847f0ed45d33.en: “My own lab soreno! Fucking, finally!” A familiar girly voice spoke right in front of Harry as if she was squatting in front of him.
847f0ed45d33.t: “Soreno makmal aku sendiri! Akhirnya, celaka!” Suara gadis yang dikenali bercakap betul-betul di hadapan Harry seolah-olah dia mencangkung di hadapannya.

84e24f483525.en: “Sorry, but how far away is Fishing Tree?” Harry brought the map upfront, pointing right at the center of Sanbi Kingdom.
84e24f483525.t: “Maaf, tapi berapa jauh Fishing Tree?” Harry membawa peta itu ke depan, menunjuk tepat di tengah Kerajaan Sanbi.

86d804776e50.en: I hope this is it! Harry looked at the gloom in the sky growing closer. Wait—this is going to The Dead Wozen stop, so are we going to ride all the way there? We’re gonna be riding all night! Harry looked towards the dark forest around him. An eerie vibe hampered the thrill of discovery. “Sinoi?”
86d804776e50.t: Harap-harap inilah dia! Harry memandang cahaya samar di langit yang semakin dekat. Kejap—ni menuju ke hentian The Dead Wozen, jadi kita akan naik sampai ke sana ke? Kita akan naik sepanjang malam! Harry memandang ke arah hutan gelap di sekelilingnya. Aura yang menyeramkan mengganggu keseronokan penemuan. “Sinoi?”

885f09245f58.en: Arukia took another large bite, leaving barely a bite-sized piece left. With one hand still hiding her chewing mouth, she brought the leftovers towards Harry’s mouth.
885f09245f58.t: Arukia menggigit besar lagi, hanya meninggalkan sekeping sebesar satu gigitan. Dengan sebelah tangan masih menyembunyikan mulutnya yang mengunyah, dia membawa baki itu ke mulut Harry.

88b59f936219.en: Chapter II – Sanbi-Eye · Vol 2 - Lab Soreno · #HusbandOutWorld
88b59f936219.t: Bab II – Sanbi-Eye · Jilid 2 - Soreno Makmal · #HusbandOutWorld

89adc2a456e4.en: Sora withdrew her head in shame. She would be a clump of carapace if she were an armadillo.
89adc2a456e4.t: Sora menarik kepalanya ke dalam kerana malu. Dia akan menjadi gumpalan cengkerang jika dia seekor armadilo.

8dba8105e02d.en: “Don’t call her that!” Eiri laughed it off as she nodded her head towards the atrium.
8dba8105e02d.t: “Jangan panggil dia macam tu!” Eiri ketawa melepaskannya sambil menganggukkan kepalanya ke arah atrium.

8e8f1abb30ac.en: Itanema didn’t seem to flinch or care much about the skin of her fingers sizzling like the meat cuts roasting over the fire.
8e8f1abb30ac.t: Itanema tidak kelihatan tersentak atau terlalu peduli tentang kulit jarinya yang berdesir seperti potongan daging yang dipanggang di atas api.

97b4421dba42.en: The carriage entered the village. A cluster of cheaply put palisades defended groups of homes surrounding the main street, where a few shops and taverns were packed closely together in a widening straight road. In the center of the road, a small town square, or, more accurately, a village square, was accented with a giant bonfire contrasting the white light of the fost stones.
97b4421dba42.t: Kereta itu memasuki kampung. Sekelompok pagar kayu yang dipasang dengan murah mempertahankan kumpulan rumah yang mengelilingi jalan utama, di mana beberapa kedai dan kedai minum berasak-asak di sepanjang jalan lurus yang semakin lebar. Di tengah jalan, sebuah dataran pekan kecil, atau lebih tepat, dataran kampung, dihiasi unggun api gergasi yang kontras dengan cahaya putih fost stone.

99d4907a6925.en: Putting his long Joe away quickly, he kept pissing in his underwear and his pants were getting wet as his feet took off after Sinoi. “SINOI! MY BAG! PLEASE STOP! SINOI!” Harry continued running towards the carriage, but his feet struck something, and he came crashing down forward, tasting the fresh earthiness as his mouth, face, and eyes were plastered with moist dirt. He pushed himself forward with burning eyes to stand up and run again. His heart felt like it was about to explode as the same old feeling of drinking an entire pot of coffee surged even stronger than before, taking away his breath. He tried to tap into that raw energy to keep running at full throttle, but then his legs gave in. Once again, his whole body slumped forward like a tree falling in the woods.
99d4907a6925.t: Menyimpan batangnya dengan cepat, dia terus terkencing dalam seluar dalamnya dan seluarnya semakin basah ketika kakinya meluru mengejar Sinoi. “SINOI! BEG SAYA! TOLONG BERHENTI! SINOI!” Harry terus berlari ke arah kereta itu, tetapi kakinya terlanggar sesuatu, dan dia jatuh tersembam ke depan, merasa kesegaran tanah ketika mulut, muka dan matanya dipaliti tanah yang lembap. Dia menolak dirinya ke depan dengan mata yang pedih untuk berdiri dan berlari lagi. Jantungnya terasa seperti hendak meletup ketika perasaan lama seperti minum seteko kopi melonjak lebih kuat daripada sebelumnya, merampas nafasnya. Dia cuba memanfaatkan tenaga mentah itu untuk terus berlari sekuat hati, tetapi kemudian kakinya mengalah. Sekali lagi, seluruh tubuhnya rebah ke depan seperti pokok tumbang di hutan.

9d50c46bdbc8.en: The same odd short double high-pitched call echoed in the forest again, but it seemed louder and closer this time. Goosebumps rushed through Harry as he made himself small, trying to retreat from the source. His teary, dilating eyes made it a tad easier to see the path versus the forest, but he couldn’t see the details of the rough ground anymore as it was way too dark. What should I do? What should I do? He tried to mask his intense breathing by opening a large, wide mouth, but one could still hear the panic swelling with each breath. Cold sweat poured from every pore in his body as he continued to walk backward, clashing his back against a tree.
9d50c46bdbc8.t: Panggilan berganda pendek bernada tinggi yang ganjil itu bergema di hutan lagi, tetapi ia kedengaran lebih kuat dan lebih dekat kali ini. Bulu roma Harry meremang ketika dia mengecilkan dirinya, cuba berundur dari sumber bunyi itu. Matanya yang berair dan membesar menjadikannya sedikit lebih mudah untuk melihat laluan berbanding hutan, tetapi dia tidak dapat melihat butiran tanah yang kasar lagi kerana terlalu gelap. Apa aku patut buat? Apa aku patut buat? Dia cuba menyembunyikan nafasnya yang kuat dengan membuka mulut lebar-lebar, tetapi orang masih dapat mendengar panik yang membengkak dengan setiap nafas. Peluh sejuk mencurah dari setiap liang roma di tubuhnya ketika dia terus berjalan ke belakang, belakangnya merempuh sebatang pokok.

9ef993490e4c.en: The sound of the egua trotting merged with the usual creaks of the carriage as it gathered speed. Meanwhile, the fost lamp in the carriage left the darkness to swallow Harry.
9ef993490e4c.t: Bunyi egua berlari anak bercampur dengan keriut biasa kereta ketika ia semakin laju. Sementara itu, lampu fost di kereta meninggalkan kegelapan untuk menelan Harry.

a0822851a832.en: Harry could hear multiple footsteps coming close by, slowing down as if searching for him—for sure, there was more than one person. He tried to stop breathing, but the feeling of suffocation overrode his power and forced him to take another anguished breath. I wanna go home! I just want to go home! He closed his eyes and tried not to listen to the footsteps growing closer and closer, but that’s all his mind focused on. Curling up in a fetal position, at least he thought his body was doing it; tears ran down his eyes and into the moist ground beneath him. A sniff involuntarily came out as the tears grew into a sob. Eiri! Please help me! Eiri’s image came to Harry’s mind as the footsteps passed close by.
a0822851a832.t: Harry dapat mendengar beberapa bunyi tapak kaki semakin hampir, memperlahankan seolah-olah mencarinya—pasti, ada lebih daripada seorang. Dia cuba berhenti bernafas, tetapi perasaan lemas mengatasi kuasanya dan memaksanya menarik satu lagi nafas yang terseksa. Aku nak balik rumah! Aku cuma nak balik rumah! Dia memejamkan matanya dan cuba tidak mendengar bunyi tapak kaki yang semakin hampir dan hampir, tetapi itu sahaja yang ditumpukan fikirannya. Meringkuk dalam posisi janin, sekurang-kurangnya dia fikir tubuhnya melakukannya; air mata mengalir dari matanya dan ke tanah lembap di bawahnya. Satu hingusan terlepas tanpa sengaja ketika air mata itu bertukar menjadi esakan. Eiri! Tolong saya! Imej Eiri terlintas di fikiran Harry ketika bunyi tapak kaki itu berlalu dekat.

a0de54d949f9.en: Feeling the road getting bumpier again as the carriage exited the modest-looking village, an eerie sensation came back to him as he stared into the darkness of the forests. The stabbing pain in his bladder grew more intense, putting more pressure on a decisive action. “Sinoi—sorry, but when can we stop? Urgh—I really need to pee!” A bit of pee came out as he clenched his detrusor muscles even more, begging them to be a bit more patient.
a0de54d949f9.t: Merasakan jalan menjadi semakin berlubang lagi ketika kereta itu keluar dari kampung yang kelihatan sederhana itu, sensasi menyeramkan kembali kepadanya ketika dia merenung ke dalam kegelapan hutan. Kesakitan menikam di pundi kencingnya menjadi semakin kuat, memberikan lebih tekanan untuk tindakan tegas. “Sinoi—maaf, tapi bila kita boleh berhenti? Urgh—saya betul-betul nak kencing!” Sedikit air kencing keluar ketika dia mengetatkan otot detrusornya lagi, merayu supaya ia bersabar sedikit lagi.

a0eeab240748.en: Drinking from where the lip mark stained the glass was, Harry could taste the defeat as he saw Arukia swing her tantalizing hips towards the door that separated the atrium and kitchen.
a0eeab240748.t: Minum dari tempat kesan bibir mengotorkan gelas itu, Harry dapat merasa kekalahan ketika dia melihat Arukia melenggangkan pinggulnya yang menggoda ke arah pintu yang memisahkan atrium dan dapur.

a275d8650425.en: A band of six people led the party with loud live music, and a single girl with an unnaturally bulged throat sang away a cheery song that had to be medieval bluegrass. The city folk with their fancy life don’t have nothin’ on our way of life! City girls salivate over sapphire balls! But we village girls never left our mates with blue balls. The crowd sang the chorus outright perfectly. They joyfully danced to the fast rhythm, almost trying to outdo the musicians’ energy.
a275d8650425.t: Sebuah kumpulan enam orang memimpin pesta dengan muzik secara langsung yang kuat, dan seorang gadis dengan kerongkong yang membonjol luar biasa menyanyikan lagu ceria yang pasti bluegrass zaman pertengahan. Orang kota dengan hidup mewah mereka, tak setanding cara hidup kami! Gadis kota meleleh air liur tengok bola sapphire! Tapi kami gadis kampung tak pernah biar bola pasangan kami jadi biru. Orang ramai menyanyikan korusnya dengan sempurna. Mereka menari dengan gembira mengikut rentak yang laju, hampir cuba mengatasi tenaga pemuzik.

a2873f6bb369.en: The carriage veered off to the right, disappearing and taking the white light of the fost lamp with it. Sinoi never looked back.
a2873f6bb369.t: Kereta itu membelok ke kanan, hilang dan membawa cahaya putih lampu fost bersamanya. Sinoi tidak pernah menoleh.

a3ddc4f2e315.en: Harry hid himself behind the tree, then tried to peek towards where the arrow came from, but didn’t see anything. Is someone hunting me? Was Sinoi with them? Wait! Did Eiri know about this too? Harry looked around, hoping to see anything or anyone else, but it was even darker inside the forest. I have to get out! Harry pushed himself forward, trying not to make noise as he walked deeper into the woods, away from whoever or whatever that was. With his hand moving outwardly, he was trying to find another tree to hide behind.
a3ddc4f2e315.t: Harry menyembunyikan dirinya di sebalik pokok, kemudian cuba mengintai ke arah dari mana anak panah itu datang, tetapi tidak nampak apa-apa. Ada orang tengah buru aku ke? Sinoi bersekongkol dengan mereka ke? Kejap! Eiri tahu pasal ni juga ke? Harry memandang sekeliling, berharap dapat melihat apa-apa atau sesiapa lagi, tetapi lebih gelap di dalam hutan. Aku kena keluar! Harry menolak dirinya ke depan, cuba tidak membuat bunyi sambil berjalan lebih dalam ke hutan, menjauhi siapa atau apa pun itu. Dengan tangannya bergerak ke luar, dia cuba mencari pokok lain untuk bersembunyi.

a590e3b8ec31.en: As if he had reclaimed a piece of himself, Harry grabbed his badge, lightly touching Sora’s fingers in the process, making her blush even more—if that was even possible. “Thanks, Sora!” Looking at his badge, he placed his thumb on the base of the thermometer-like apparatus, making a glimmering light appear on the thinner portion. He looked back at Sora with a broad smile, showing the glimmering light to her.
a590e3b8ec31.t: Seolah-olah dia telah menuntut kembali sebahagian dirinya, Harry mengambil lencananya, menyentuh jari Sora dengan perlahan dalam proses itu, membuatkannya lebih merah lagi—kalau itu pun mungkin. “Terima kasih, Sora!” Memandang lencananya, dia meletakkan ibu jarinya di pangkal alat seperti termometer itu, membuatkan cahaya berkilauan muncul di bahagian yang lebih nipis. Dia memandang kembali Sora dengan senyuman lebar, menunjukkan cahaya berkilauan itu kepadanya.

a75dd37fc828.en: Harry silently watched Arukia take small sips of a full glass of water. Part of him wanted to ask for it too, but the other part internally loudly exclaimed, Nope—you don’t deserve it.
a75dd37fc828.t: Harry memerhati dalam diam Arukia menghirup sedikit demi sedikit segelas penuh air. Sebahagian dirinya mahu memintanya juga, tetapi sebahagian lagi berseru kuat dalam hati, Tak—kau tak layak.

a938b9c7305b.en: “This fucking thing!” A girly voice very loudly whispered from the same direction where the sharp metallic bang sounded off. Harry felt a familiar tone to it but couldn’t pinpoint who it was.
a938b9c7305b.t: “Benda celaka ni!” Suara gadis berbisik dengan sangat kuat dari arah yang sama di mana dentuman logam tajam itu kedengaran. Harry merasakan nada yang biasa padanya tetapi tidak dapat menentukan siapa.

ac0e18ca188e.en: “With due respect, please finish him already.” A male voice pleaded to the girl, but it didn’t seem remorseful. Instead, its deadpan delivery sounded like he was trying to get this over with. “We are diverging from the schedule.”
ac0e18ca188e.t: “Dengan segala hormatnya, tolong habiskan dia segera.” Suara lelaki merayu kepada gadis itu, tetapi ia tidak kedengaran menyesal. Sebaliknya, penyampaiannya yang tanpa ekspresi kedengaran seperti dia cuba menyelesaikan perkara ini. “Kita sudah tersasar dari jadual.”

aea993389ca4.en: “I’DON’CAR’. G’PEE!” Sinoi cut through Harry’s cowardly call.
aea993389ca4.t: “A’TA’KI’SAH. PI’KEN’CING!” Sinoi memotong panggilan pengecut Harry.

af51530dca3a.en: With nothing but an embarrassed laugh, Harry walked together with the two maids out into the sunny afternoon. He felt the sunshine play warmly with his skin as the same breeze of sea mixed with fish ruffled the grass and plants. Meanwhile, a butterfly feeling tickled his inner gut—perhaps it was a hunger for food, hunger for Sora, or both.
af51530dca3a.t: Dengan hanya ketawa malu, Harry berjalan bersama dua pembantu rumah itu keluar ke petang yang cerah. Dia merasakan cahaya matahari bermain dengan hangat di kulitnya ketika bayu laut bercampur ikan yang sama mengusutkan rumput dan tumbuh-tumbuhan. Sementara itu, perasaan seperti rama-rama menggeletek perut dalamnya—mungkin itu lapar akan makanan, lapar akan Sora, atau kedua-duanya.

b43d62ca262f.en: “You’re still doing that? Argh! The trash is literally over here!” Arukia clicked her tongue loudly this time as Itanema pulled on the handle to wash her hands. Arukia’s tone grew taut as she spoke over the angry gush of water roaring in the kitchen, “Fine! I will tell her that you washed your hands this time.”
b43d62ca262f.t: “Kau masih buat macam tu? Argh! Tong sampah betul-betul kat sini!” Arukia mendecit lidahnya dengan kuat kali ini ketika Itanema menarik pemegang untuk mencuci tangannya. Nada Arukia menjadi tegang ketika dia bercakap mengatasi curahan air marah yang mengaum di dapur, “Baiklah! Aku akan bagi tahu dia yang kau cuci tangan kali ni.”

b52f665e9394.en: Doesn’t that hurt? Harry kept looking at her blistering fingers as she kept turning the delicious-looking and delicious-smelling meats.
b52f665e9394.t: Tak sakit ke tu? Harry terus memandang jarinya yang melepuh sambil dia terus membalikkan daging-daging yang kelihatan dan berbau sedap itu.

b6f46c7960fc.en: Itanema glanced at Arukia, and Harry, then back at her hands without saying anything. Her neutral expression didn’t appear to have much to say either as she pushed on the handle to stop the angry gush of water, bringing a silence to the room.
b6f46c7960fc.t: Itanema mengerling Arukia, dan Harry, kemudian kembali ke tangannya tanpa berkata apa-apa. Riak neutralnya tidak kelihatan mempunyai banyak untuk dikatakan juga sambil dia menolak pemegang untuk menghentikan curahan air marah, membawa kesunyian ke bilik itu.

ba0702cba24f.en: The vicious girly giggles grew quieter.
ba0702cba24f.t: Kekekan gadis yang ganas itu menjadi lebih senyap.

bbc5b26a1d52.en: Check, map? Harry scooched back on his seat and rested his brownish furry leather bag on his lap. Untying the strap in the center, he opened it up. He saw a collection of goodies inside. Two journals with leather strap cover, a folded heavy-paper pamphlet, a writing feather, a somewhat-small leather water bottle filled to the brim, one tube of ink corked tightly, a wax seal toolkit to make blue Sanbi wax seals, Sanbi mail postcard-sized envelopes—whitish in color, and a leather purse. Pulling out the purse, it felt somewhat heavy. Hmmm*—kinda looks like what Hiromi had?* Once he opened it, he saw nothing but a bunch of pearls wrapped in the same golden medal. No amethysts? Oh well. Harry looked for a spot in his bag to secure his badge but found none. I guess I will just put it with my money before I lose it. He placed his badge into the purse; Harry closed it tightly, then slipped it back into the bag. Now that I think about it—I thought money came in bills! Like paper-shape, greenish—oh yeah! There were cents too! Like in the shape of round metal things.
bbc5b26a1d52.t: Tengok, peta? Harry mengesot kembali ke tempat duduknya dan meletakkan beg kulit berbulu keperangannya di ribanya. Membuka ikatan tali di tengah, dia membukanya. Dia nampak koleksi barang-barang di dalamnya. Dua buah jurnal dengan kulit bertali kulit, sebuah risalah kertas tebal yang dilipat, sebatang bulu pena, botol air kulit yang agak kecil diisi penuh, satu tiub dakwat yang ditutup rapat dengan gabus, set alat cop lilin untuk membuat cop lilin Sanbi biru, sampul surat Sanbi mail sebesar poskad—berwarna keputihan, dan sebuah dompet kulit. Mengeluarkan dompet itu, ia terasa agak berat. Hmmm*—macam yang Hiromi ada?* Sebaik sahaja dia membukanya, dia tidak nampak apa-apa selain sekumpulan Pearl yang dibalut logam emas yang sama. Tak ada amethyst? Tak apalah. Harry mencari tempat dalam begnya untuk menyimpan lencananya dengan selamat tetapi tidak menemuinya. Rasanya aku simpan je dengan duit aku sebelum aku hilangkan. Dia meletakkan lencananya ke dalam dompet; Harry menutupnya rapat-rapat, kemudian menyelitkannya kembali ke dalam beg. Bila difikirkan—aku ingat duit datang dalam bentuk wang kertas!
