Macam bentuk kertas, kehijauan—oh ya! Ada sen juga! Macam bentuk benda logam bulat.

bd606b703f1b.en: With a shameful shake of the head, Sora seemingly refused to make eye contact, leaving Harry to hang like a sheet being dried in the wind.
bd606b703f1b.t: Dengan gelengan kepala yang malu, Sora nampaknya enggan bertentang mata, membiarkan Harry tergantung seperti cadar yang dijemur ditiup angin.

bdd913d1e4f4.en: “Really? Are you trying to get a harem by pursuing her too?” Eiri smirked with mischievous laughter as she propped the kitchen door open. “Itanema does like it hot and steamy more than anyone I’ve seen!”
bdd913d1e4f4.t: “Biar betul? Kau cuba nak dapat harem dengan mengejar dia juga ke?” Eiri tersenyum sinis dengan ketawa nakal sambil menahan pintu dapur terbuka. “Itanema memang suka yang panas dan berwap lebih daripada sesiapa yang pernah aku jumpa!”

c044496eafef.en: “What? I’m not going to tell you as you go! You’re the Sanbi-eye!” Arukia’s frown and pout looked like her tolerance for his stupidity was quickly drying up. She took another bite, but this time she chomped at least half of what was left, hiding away her chewing mouth behind her hand.
c044496eafef.t: “Apa? Aku takkan bagi tahu kau sepanjang jalan! Kau Sanbi-eye!” Kerutan dan muncung Arukia kelihatan seperti kesabarannya terhadap kebodohan Harry cepat kering. Dia menggigit lagi, tetapi kali ini dia mengunyah sekurang-kurangnya separuh daripada baki, menyembunyikan mulutnya yang mengunyah di sebalik tangannya.

c6b3e634b4b6.en: “Huh?” Eiri elbowed Harry. “Maybe you have a chance on the harem after all—if you put her as the primary.”
c6b3e634b4b6.t: “Hah?” Eiri menyiku Harry. “Mungkin kau ada peluang untuk harem tu rupanya—kalau kau jadikan dia yang utama.”

c9ec5c151f40.en: “Wa’?” Sinoi replied in a short burst of wakefulness, his tone seeming more annoyed than before.
c9ec5c151f40.t: “Pa’?” Sinoi menjawab dalam letusan jaga yang singkat, nadanya kedengaran lebih jengkel daripada tadi.

cbd03a9dbe76.en: I drop you off the share wagon. You go—fish tree? The difficulty of that decryption was a bit too high for Harry’s ears. “Fish tree?”
cbd03a9dbe76.t: Aku turunkan kau kat kereta kongsi. Kau pergi—Fish Tree? Kesukaran nyahsulit itu agak terlalu tinggi untuk telinga Harry. “Fish Tree?”

cf7421223cb8.en: Another whooshing sound came through, but this time it didn’t miss. It struck Harry from the back right between the clavicle and scapula of his right shoulder. The arrow lodged itself deep in the muscle, rupturing tendons.
cf7421223cb8.t: Satu lagi bunyi desiran datang, tetapi kali ini ia tidak tersasar. Ia mengenai Harry dari belakang tepat di antara tulang selangka dan tulang belikat bahu kanannya. Anak panah itu tertancap jauh di dalam otot, memutuskan urat.

d1c0d9019fe9.en: I will drop you off farther away—just relax? Harry just gained a level in his decryption skills. “Ahh—thanks? Oh, Eiri said you would give extra details too?”
d1c0d9019fe9.t: Aku akan turunkan kau jauh sikit—rilek aje? Harry baru naik satu tahap dalam kemahiran menyahsulitnya. “Ahh—terima kasih? Oh, Eiri kata pak cik akan bagi butiran tambahan juga?”

d1c5e706c794.en: “ARGH!” Harry screamed in pain as his shoulder made a popping sound. His right arm grew weak, and he couldn’t lift it properly anymore. He tried but was met with more popping sounds as hot, aching pain radiated from deep in his shoulder and into his neck and right arm. The pain conflicted with a sudden wave of cool, refreshing sensation emanating from the tip of the arrow lodged inside him. That weird sensation began spreading through his shoulder.
d1c5e706c794.t: “ARGH!” Harry menjerit kesakitan sementara bahunya berbunyi meletup. Lengan kanannya menjadi lemah, dan dia tidak dapat mengangkatnya dengan betul lagi. Dia mencuba tetapi disambut lebih banyak bunyi meletup ketika kesakitan panas yang berdenyut terpancar dari dalam bahunya dan ke leher serta lengan kanannya. Kesakitan itu bercanggah dengan gelombang sensasi sejuk dan menyegarkan yang tiba-tiba terpancar dari hujung anak panah yang tertancap di dalamnya. Sensasi aneh itu mula merebak ke seluruh bahunya.

d23aa0066036.en: “It’s easy! Just find an embassy, and they will take care of you!” Eiri pointed at Harry’s badge. “That’s why I told you not to lose that, or you’re gonna be boned.” Eiri chuckled. “Like, really boned! Not the good kind of boning either!”
d23aa0066036.t: “Senang je! Cari kedutaan, dan mereka akan uruskan untuk kau!” Eiri menunjuk ke arah lencana Harry. “Sebab tulah aku suruh kau jangan hilangkan tu, kalau tak kau akan kena kerjakan.” Eiri tergelak kecil. “Macam, betul-betul kena kerjakan! Bukan jenis kerja yang seronok tu pula!”

d3314d399ad6.en: Harry’s reddened, watering eyes still had dirt rubbing against his irises. Clearing it again, he focused on the dying sky switching from a reddish-purple-orange into a greenish blue hue. Everything else was covered by darkness. He felt a brisk wind pass by, chilling his scratched arms and the tears pouring down his face. His hearing tuned to every little sound around him. The whistle of the wind against the rustles of the leaves and the animal calls in the night seemed to be taunting him, waiting for him to break down in tears and call for his mommy.
d3314d399ad6.t: Mata Harry yang merah dan berair masih ada tanah yang bergesel dengan irisnya. Membersihkannya lagi, dia menumpukan perhatian pada langit yang semakin malap bertukar dari merah-ungu-jingga kepada warna biru kehijauan. Segala yang lain diselubungi kegelapan. Dia merasakan angin segar berlalu, menyejukkan lengannya yang tercalar dan air mata yang mencurah di wajahnya. Pendengarannya menala setiap bunyi kecil di sekelilingnya. Siulan angin melawan gemersik daun dan panggilan haiwan pada waktu malam seakan-akan mengejeknya, menunggu dia menangis teresak-esak dan memanggil mamanya.

d68be10aa14f.en: Harry was seated silently in the kitchen, making ASMR sounds as his teeth ripped apart the crunchy multigrain bread of a meaty sandwich. His palate was pleased from no longer being bombarded by strong alcohol, instead tasting the leafy greens contrasting the spiciness and saltiness of a nice chunk of meat loaded inside—it had a cured pork-like taste, chewy texture to it, but it wasn’t overly salty. Everything seemed quiet and peaceful, at least until a certain maid by the name of Arukia burst through the swinging door with teapots and mugs, dropped them in the large sink, looked around the room, then invited herself to sit right by Harry. She approached so close that he could smell her slightly bubblegum-with-grape perfume—very girly, yes, but at the same time, it was kinda ruining his tasty sandwich.
d68be10aa14f.t: Harry duduk diam di dapur, membuat bunyi ASMR ketika giginya mengoyakkan roti bijirin pelbagai yang rangup dalam sandwic berdaging. Lelangitnya gembira kerana tidak lagi dibedil alkohol kuat, sebaliknya merasa sayur-sayuran berdaun yang kontras dengan kepedasan dan kemasinan seketul daging yang sedap yang dimuatkan di dalamnya—ia mempunyai rasa seperti daging babi yang diawet, tekstur kenyal, tetapi tidak terlalu masin. Segala-galanya kelihatan senyap dan aman, sekurang-kurangnya sehingga seorang pembantu rumah tertentu bernama Arukia merempuh masuk melalui pintu ayun dengan teko dan kole, menjatuhkannya ke dalam sinki besar, memandang sekeliling bilik, kemudian menjemput dirinya sendiri duduk betul-betul di sebelah Harry. Dia mendekat begitu rapat sehingga Harry dapat menghidu minyak wanginya yang sedikit berbau gula-gula getah dengan anggur—sangat keanak-gadisan, ya, tetapi pada masa yang sama, ia agak merosakkan sandwicnya yang sedap.

d8b54b66d5a1.en: A vicious girly laugh emanated from behind Harry, making its way towards him.
d8b54b66d5a1.t: Ketawa gadis yang ganas terpancar dari belakang Harry, menuju ke arahnya.

dae08eb2a43b.en: A tree branch smacked Harry in the face, forcing him to retreat towards the center of the carriage. I thought the road was straight? Harry wiped away the scratches and leaves on his face. The narrow road made the forest creepier, as if it was ready to jump on him at any second. Harry then jumped in his seat when a cluster of wingas flew from off a nearby tree, screaming at the top of their lungs. His heart pounded as quickly as the live music he heard before. This wired energy feeling inside him grew more real, trying to tell him something, but he just couldn’t figure out what.
dae08eb2a43b.t: Sebatang dahan pokok menampar muka Harry, memaksanya berundur ke tengah kereta. Aku ingat jalan ni lurus? Harry mengesat calar dan daun di mukanya. Jalan yang sempit itu menjadikan hutan lebih menyeramkan, seolah-olah ia bersedia untuk menerkamnya pada bila-bila masa. Harry kemudian terlompat di tempat duduknya apabila sekumpulan winga terbang dari pokok berdekatan, menjerit sekuat hati. Jantungnya berdegup selaju muzik secara langsung yang didengarnya tadi. Perasaan tenaga teruja dalam dirinya ini menjadi lebih nyata, cuba memberitahunya sesuatu, tetapi dia tidak dapat memahami apa.

db1fa803d660.en: He looked around, trying to transform the unknown into know.
db1fa803d660.t: Dia memandang sekeliling, cuba mengubah yang tidak diketahui menjadi diketahui.

dc82e80bb5cd.en: “Hey, Sinoi! Take good care of my Harry! I will do the same for Itanema too!” Eiri exclaimed from afar, waving a friendly goodbye.
dc82e80bb5cd.t: “Hei, Sinoi! Jaga Harry aku baik-baik! Aku akan buat benda yang sama untuk Itanema juga!” Eiri berseru dari jauh, melambai selamat tinggal dengan mesra.

df8bbb23ad40.en: Harry nodded with a smile from ear to ear. Feeling like a bird about to jump the nest, he walked towards the carriage Eiri pointed at. That’s kinda old. The carriage looked like the oldest of all the carriages he had seen passing by, even more so than another parked nearby. It looked like it had survived at least three wars—world wars! That’s huge! I thought they were the same size as horses! The egua pulling the cart seemed to be taken good care of, at least based on its shiny and voluptuous mane. An old-looking person was up front, holding the coachwhip to control the horse-like mammal. “Hi, Sinoi!” Harry said to the old man, who looked like he was about to fall asleep—or already deeply sleeping.
df8bbb23ad40.t: Harry mengangguk dengan senyuman dari telinga ke telinga. Merasakan seperti burung yang hendak melompat dari sarang, dia berjalan ke arah kereta kuda yang ditunjukkan Eiri. Tu agak lama. Kereta kuda itu kelihatan seperti yang paling lama daripada semua kereta kuda yang dilihatnya lalu, malah lebih daripada satu lagi yang diletakkan berdekatan. Ia kelihatan seperti telah bertahan sekurang-kurangnya tiga peperangan—perang dunia! Besarnya! Aku ingat ia sama saiz dengan kuda! Egua yang menarik kereta itu kelihatan dijaga dengan baik, sekurang-kurangnya berdasarkan suraiannya yang berkilat dan lebat. Seorang yang kelihatan tua berada di depan, memegang cemeti kusir untuk mengawal mamalia seperti kuda itu. “Hai, Sinoi!” kata Harry kepada lelaki tua itu, yang kelihatan seperti hendak tertidur—atau sudah tidur nyenyak.

e012319bacfa.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 3: Harry waves toward a village at dusk where people gather around a campfire.
e012319bacfa.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 3: Harry melambai ke arah sebuah kampung pada waktu senja di mana orang ramai berkumpul di sekeliling unggun api.

e32dc5391ae3.en: Harry, with sauce on his lips, looked towards the closed door, then back at Itanema behind him. I wonder if I can ask her for another sandwich. He saw her struggling to turn over the hunks of meat, then using her bare hands to help flip the meat.
e32dc5391ae3.t: Harry, dengan sos di bibirnya, memandang ke arah pintu yang tertutup, kemudian kembali ke arah Itanema di belakangnya. Boleh tak aku minta dia buatkan sandwic lagi satu agaknya. Dia melihatnya bergelut membalikkan ketulan daging, kemudian menggunakan tangan kosongnya untuk membantu membalikkan daging itu.

e7c986a2ab9b.en: The Dead Wozen? That’s the tavern Hiromi met Yacamim! Harry’s eyes lit up, seeing a shared wagon stop towards the eastern edge of the map. With a broad smile, as he looked at how to get there from Sanbi Castle, he counted the cost to be nine pearls, and shared wagons were passing by every day. Cool! It’s on the way to Fishing Tree too!
e7c986a2ab9b.t: The Dead Wozen? Itu kedai minum tempat Hiromi jumpa Yacamim! Mata Harry bersinar, melihat sebuah hentian kereta kongsi ke arah pinggir timur peta. Dengan senyuman lebar, sambil melihat cara untuk ke sana dari Sanbi Castle, dia mengira kosnya sembilan Pearl, dan kereta kongsi lalu setiap hari. Best! Ia sejalan ke Fishing Tree juga!

e89d272dfb1b.en: Meanwhile, the egua’s autopilot kept marching along this empty narrower rough road while Sinoi kept on chewing his mostly gone stick, looking even more immobile than before.
e89d272dfb1b.t: Sementara itu, juruterbang automatik egua terus mara di sepanjang jalan sempit yang kasar dan lengang ini sementara Sinoi terus mengunyah kayunya yang hampir habis, kelihatan lebih kaku daripada tadi.

ebb0fd767226.en: She placed her right hand right over her fun valley and spoke softly with a half-smile. “Guess right, and you can take a closer peek.”
ebb0fd767226.t: Dia meletakkan tangan kanannya betul-betul di atas lembah keseronokannya dan bercakap perlahan dengan separuh senyuman. “Teka betul, dan kau boleh intai dekat sikit.”

ec2a22ff7aaf.en: “Celerino Sanbi Royal.” Itanema promptly replied like a reflex rather than a memory. She kept brooming the dirt towards a corner with a slow but steady rhythm.
ec2a22ff7aaf.t: “Celerino Sanbi Royal.” Itanema menjawab dengan segera seperti refleks dan bukannya ingatan. Dia terus menyapu habuk ke sudut dengan rentak yang perlahan tetapi tetap.

ed018766ec2d.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 2: Harry waves from a wagon beside an old man with a pipe, three girls standing in the street behind.
ed018766ec2d.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 2: Harry melambai dari kereta kuda di sebelah seorang lelaki tua berpaip, tiga gadis berdiri di jalan di belakang.

ed349a75831e.en: Harry was seated silently in the kitchen, making ASMR sounds as his teeth ripped apart the crunchy multigrain bread of a meaty sandwich.
ed349a75831e.t: Harry duduk diam di dapur, membuat bunyi ASMR ketika giginya mengoyakkan roti bijirin pelbagai yang rangup dalam sandwic berdaging.

ede758a51a0b.en: With a motherly hug, Eiri spoke in his ear. “Don’t worry too much! Just live day by day, and send me as many winga mails as you want! I will be sure to reply to them!”
ede758a51a0b.t: Dengan pelukan keibuan, Eiri bercakap di telinganya. “Jangan risau sangat! Hidup je hari demi hari, dan hantar aku winga mail sebanyak mana yang kau nak! Aku pasti akan balas!”

ee9a563609e1.en: “Harry! Ready to go?” Eiri slowly poked through the swinging door, holding a furry, leathery bag with a shoulder strap. The bag had red strands of hair on the side, accenting its brownish fur.
ee9a563609e1.t: “Harry! Dah sedia nak pergi?” Eiri perlahan-lahan menjengul melalui pintu ayun, memegang beg kulit berbulu dengan tali bahu. Beg itu mempunyai helaian rambut merah di sisi, menonjolkan bulu keperangannya.

f0d6bcdea74c.en: Trying to juggle his memories again, Harry remembered another factoid. “Neferteri for monarchy!”
f0d6bcdea74c.t: Cuba menyusun ingatannya lagi, Harry teringat satu lagi fakta kecil. “Neferteri untuk monarki!”

f48b35814183.en: He has a contract to fill too? The bumps of the carriage grew more intense, making him feel pinching in his bladder. “I’m sorry, Sinoi, but I need to pee!”
f48b35814183.t: Dia pun ada kontrak nak dipenuhi juga? Hentakan kereta menjadi semakin kuat, membuatkannya merasakan cubitan di pundi kencingnya. “Maaf, Sinoi, tapi saya nak kencing!”

f529739efc27.en: “Eiri for economical?” Harry looked at Arukia like he were asking for a plea deal. His eyes looked only, and only, at her brightly cyan eyes—even though there was still the same gravity pull towards the fun in between her breast valleys.
f529739efc27.t: “Eiri untuk ekonomi?” Harry memandang Arukia seperti dia meminta perjanjian rayuan. Matanya hanya, dan hanya, memandang mata biru kehijauannya yang terang—walaupun masih ada tarikan graviti yang sama ke arah keseronokan di antara lembah buah dadanya.

f5aee3980a6d.en: Noticing Sora’s armadillo mode, Eiri poked her sides. “C’mon, Sora! I didn’t even say banging this time! Hmmm, or is the shy mode because you actually don’t want to say bye to your future husband?”
f5aee3980a6d.t: Perasan mod armadilo Sora, Eiri mencucuk sisinya. “Alah, Sora! Aku tak sebut pun main kali ni! Hmmm, atau mod malu ni sebab kau sebenarnya tak nak ucap selamat tinggal pada bakal suami kau?”

f7f47cd6e44b.en: Harry could not get himself to open his eyes; he remained in a fetal position while sobbing profusely. He pictured himself with his parents and the dog as they ate tacos and watched TV. He still couldn’t remember anything about them, but the feeling of being home was still there. I wanna go home.
f7f47cd6e44b.t: Harry tidak dapat membuka matanya; dia kekal dalam posisi janin sambil teresak-esak dengan banyak. Dia membayangkan dirinya bersama ibu bapanya dan anjing itu ketika mereka makan taco dan menonton TV. Dia masih tidak dapat mengingati apa-apa tentang mereka, tetapi perasaan berada di rumah masih ada. Aku nak balik rumah.

f9752e3e459b.en: An effervescent, butterfly feeling arose within Harry. He left the empty plate back as he stood up and began walking towards her, but his curiosity took the best out of him, taking one last look at Itanema before leaving the kitchen.
f9752e3e459b.t: Perasaan berbuih seperti rama-rama timbul dalam diri Harry. Dia meninggalkan pinggan kosong itu sambil berdiri dan mula berjalan ke arahnya, tetapi rasa ingin tahunya mengatasinya, mengerling buat kali terakhir ke arah Itanema sebelum meninggalkan dapur.

fa72c1462565.en: Feeling even more so like a déjà vu, Harry could almost see the hundreds of people gathered outside, all curiously looking at him as his previous undersized clothing was so stretched that it made his belly appear twice as big. However, this time, only tens of people were around, and they were all busy going about their business. Some carriages passed by, others walked, and some even curiously glanced at the door as they kept on going. A few gave a nod or a wave as they passed by, but that’s it. As they walked outside, Harry noticed a couple kissing passionately in front of the Sanbi fountain. Their kissing was so intense, it looked like their faces had been glued.
fa72c1462565.t: Merasakan lebih lagi seperti déjà vu, Harry hampir dapat melihat ratusan orang berkumpul di luar, semuanya memandangnya dengan ingin tahu kerana pakaiannya dahulu yang terlalu kecil begitu teregang sehingga perutnya kelihatan dua kali ganda besar. Namun, kali ini, hanya berpuluh-puluh orang di sekeliling, dan mereka semua sibuk dengan urusan masing-masing. Beberapa kereta kuda lalu, yang lain berjalan, malah ada yang mengerling dengan ingin tahu ke arah pintu sambil terus berlalu. Beberapa orang mengangguk atau melambai ketika lalu, tetapi itu sahaja. Ketika mereka berjalan keluar, Harry perasan sepasang kekasih bercium dengan penuh ghairah di hadapan air pancut Sanbi. Ciuman mereka begitu kuat, kelihatan seperti muka mereka telah digam.

fdb138c20415.en: Harry kept on releasing a torrential stream of piss as he saw the carriage gather speed. The situation seemed so unreal that Harry initially thought it was all a product of his imagination—or perhaps just a dream and that he was about to wake up on a Monday morning, staring at his phone, yearning to call in sick or tell his boss to get fucked rather than deal with that shit. Wait! What the fuck am I thinking? Harry snapped out of it as the carriage kept going. “MY BAG!” He shouted as he was still peeing.
fdb138c20415.t: Harry terus melepaskan aliran kencing yang deras sambil melihat kereta itu semakin laju. Keadaan itu kelihatan begitu tidak nyata sehingga Harry pada mulanya menyangka semuanya hasil imaginasinya—atau mungkin hanya mimpi dan dia hendak bangun pada pagi Isnin, merenung telefonnya, teringin untuk mengambil cuti sakit atau menyuruh bosnya pergi mampus daripada menghadapi benda celaka itu. Kejap! Apa celaka yang aku fikir ni? Harry tersedar ketika kereta itu terus bergerak. “BEG SAYA!” Dia menjerit sambil masih kencing.

fe741dbb138c.en: With a click of her tongue, Arukia came back to Harry and handed over a half-drank glass with a bonus faint red lip mark. “Here’s your consolation prize.”
fe741dbb138c.t: Dengan decitan lidah, Arukia kembali kepada Harry dan menyerahkan gelas yang separuh diminum dengan bonus kesan bibir merah yang samar. “Nah hadiah saguhati kau.”

ff794a2d8768.en: Making his first significant body motion, Sinoi waved his hand left as the other pulled on the reins, bringing the carriage to a slow stop in the middle of another T-shaped intersection. Going forward would keep encircling the castle walls, while turning left would go on another straight road just as large as the one they were in. This road had the identical sturdy fost stone lamp posts equally spaced from each other, each surrounded by a small garden of bluish flowers that vibrantly shined in the sunlight. Sinoi waved for a few more carriages to pass by, then he shook his reins, creaking the carriage as it turned left towards this new road.
ff794a2d8768.t: Membuat gerakan badan penting yang pertama, Sinoi melambai tangannya ke kiri sementara tangan yang lagi satu menarik tali kekang, membawa kereta itu berhenti perlahan di tengah-tengah satu lagi simpang berbentuk T. Terus ke depan akan terus mengelilingi tembok istana, manakala membelok ke kiri akan menyusuri satu lagi jalan lurus yang sama besar dengan jalan yang mereka lalui. Jalan ini mempunyai tiang lampu fost stone yang kukuh yang sama yang dijarakkan sama rata antara satu sama lain, setiap satu dikelilingi taman kecil bunga kebiruan yang bersinar terang di bawah cahaya matahari. Sinoi melambai beberapa kereta kuda lagi untuk lalu, kemudian dia menggoncang tali kekangnya, membuatkan kereta itu berkeriut ketika ia membelok ke kiri ke arah jalan baharu ini.

ffa48aefc86b.en: Sinoi returned to being immobile while the egua carried on, trotting through this darkening road. A few clusters of white gloom shone on the darkening road ahead, with a stronger white gloom in the sky far ahead—perhaps a village was waiting for them there. As they trotted towards it, the noises of the forest were overshadowed by echoes of live music—whoever was playing the trombone was going above and beyond.
ffa48aefc86b.t: Sinoi kembali kaku sementara egua terus berlari anak menyusuri jalan yang semakin gelap ini. Beberapa kelompok cahaya putih samar bersinar di jalan yang semakin gelap di depan, dengan cahaya putih yang lebih kuat di langit jauh di depan—mungkin sebuah kampung sedang menunggu mereka di sana. Ketika mereka berlari anak ke arahnya, bunyi hutan ditenggelamkan oleh gema muzik secara langsung—sesiapa yang bermain trombon itu memang bersungguh-sungguh.
